spanish_text: Aunque la propuesta fue bien recibida por los vecinos, varios representantes cuestionaron tanto su costo como la falta de un calendario claro para ejecutarla.
errors_to_catch: both… as well as / both… as
why_this_chunk: Both… and joins two matching noun phrases; calendario here is a timeline / schedule.
suggested_ok_english_hint: tanto… como pairs two objects of 'questioned'. Which English pair keeps them parallel?
english_key: Although the proposal was well received by residents, several representatives questioned both its cost and the lack of a clear timeline for implementing it.
acceptables: Although the proposal was well received by residents, several representatives questioned both its cost and the lack of a clear schedule for carrying it out.
Although the proposal was well received by local residents, several representatives questioned both its cost and the lack of a clear timeline for its implementation.

traps.comment: tanto… como = both… and. 'Both… as well as' and 'both X as Y' are nonparallel.
traps.ok: both its cost and the lack
traps.no: both its cost as well as the lack
traps.label: both… as well as / both… as
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Nonparallel constructions, p. 36

traps.comment: vecinos in a civic context = residents. 'Neighbors' reads as the people next door.
traps.label: vecinos rendered as neighbors
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: Ni los fondos adicionales ni las reformas aprobadas el año pasado han logrado reducir las demoras en la atención de las solicitudes.
why_this_chunk: Neither… nor; with nor the verb agrees with the nearer subject (reforms → have).
suggested_ok_english_hint: ni… ni + plural verb. Which conjunction pairs with neither, and what is atención de solicitudes?
english_key: Neither the additional funds nor the reforms approved last year have succeeded in reducing delays in processing applications.
acceptables: Neither the additional funding nor the reforms approved last year have managed to reduce delays in processing applications.
Neither the additional funds nor the reforms approved last year have succeeded in reducing the delays in processing applications.

traps.comment: ni… ni = neither… nor. 'Neither… or' is a nonparallel pair.
traps.label: neither paired with or
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Nonparallel constructions, p. 36

traps.comment: la atención de las solicitudes = processing / handling applications. 'Attention of applications' is a calque.
traps.label: atención calqued
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: Cuanto más se prolongue la negociación, mayor será la incertidumbre de los empleados y menores las posibilidades de llegar a un acuerdo.
why_this_chunk: The comparative correlative repeats 'the' + comparative in each part; prolongue (future reference) takes the present tense.
suggested_ok_english_hint: Cuanto más… mayor… menores: English uses a 'the -er…, the -er' frame. Keep all three parts parallel.
english_key: The longer the negotiations drag on, the greater the uncertainty among employees and the lower the chances of reaching an agreement.
acceptables: The longer the negotiations go on, the greater the uncertainty among employees and the lower the chances of reaching an agreement.
The longer the negotiation drags on, the greater the employees' uncertainty and the smaller the chances of reaching an agreement.

traps.comment: Cuanto más se prolongue = The longer…. 'How much more' is a calque.
traps.label: cuanto más calqued
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Nonparallel constructions, p. 36

traps.comment: In the subordinate half of a future comparison English uses the present: 'the longer the negotiations drag on'.
traps.label: future in the subordinate clause
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Verb tenses: Tense sequence in complex sentences referring to the future, p. 64

spanish_text: El informe recomienda que las autoridades identifiquen las causas del retraso, expliquen sus consecuencias y adopten medidas para evitar que vuelva a ocurrir.
why_this_chunk: Mandative subjunctive in a parallel series; evitar que = prevent from.
suggested_ok_english_hint: recomienda que + three subjunctives. Does any verb take -s? What does evitar que mean here?
english_key: The report recommends that the authorities identify the causes of the delay, explain its consequences, and adopt measures to prevent it from happening again.
acceptables: The report recommends that the authorities identify the causes of the delay, explain its consequences, and take measures to prevent it from happening again.
The report recommends that the authorities should identify the causes of the delay, explain its consequences, and adopt measures to keep it from recurring.

detector.pattern: \bthat the authorities (identifies|will identify)\b|\b(explains|and adopts|and takes|and adopting)

traps.comment: After recommend that…, US English uses the present (mandative) subjunctive: that X be…, that X identify…. The indicative is marked. 'should + verb' is also accepted.
traps.label: indicative after recommend that
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Subjunctive mood, p. 55

traps.comment: evitar que vuelva a ocurrir = prevent it from happening again. 'Avoid that it happens' is a calque.
traps.label: evitar que calqued
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: A pesar de que la empresa aseguró que terminaría las obras en diciembre, los residentes seguían sin recibir información sobre los cambios anunciados.
why_this_chunk: seguir sin + inf. = still had not…; obras = work / construction; month names are capitalized.
suggested_ok_english_hint: seguían sin recibir: a negative continuing state. Which English keeps both 'still' and the negation?
english_key: Even though the company said it would finish the work in December, residents still had not received any information about the announced changes.
acceptables: Even though the company had promised that it would complete the construction in December, residents still had not received any information about the changes that had been announced.
Although the company had given assurances that it would finish the work in December, residents still had not received information about the announced changes.

traps.comment: seguían sin recibir = still had not received. Dropping the negation (or 'still') changes the meaning.
traps.label: negation in seguir sin dropped
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: obras = construction / the work (mass noun). 'The works' is British or reads as 'everything'.
traps.label: obras rendered as the works
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Non-U.S. usage, p. 37

traps.comment: English capitalizes month names (December).
traps.label: month lowercased
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

spanish_text: La directora, que había asumido el cargo apenas tres meses antes, reconoció que algunas decisiones se habían tomado sin consultar a los afectados.
errors_to_catch: gender added to a neutral title
why_this_chunk: Nonrestrictive clause set off by commas; apenas tres meses = only three months; no gender added.
suggested_ok_english_hint: La directora, que…: is the clause essential or extra? What does apenas mean here?
english_key: The director, who had taken office only three months earlier, acknowledged that some decisions had been made without consulting those affected.
acceptables: The director, who had assumed the position barely three months before, acknowledged that some decisions had been made without consulting the people affected.
The director, who had taken office just three months earlier, admitted that some decisions had been made without consulting those affected.

traps.comment: apenas + quantity = only / just / barely. 'Hardly' suggests 'almost not'.
traps.label: apenas rendered as hardly
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: The director is already identified; the clause is nonrestrictive and must be set off by commas (not dashes).
traps.label: nonrestrictive commas missing
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Restrictive and nonrestrictive clauses and appositives, p. 48

traps.comment: La directora: 'director' is neutral in English. Adding 'female' adds information.
traps.label: gender added to a neutral title
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, He/she and gender-specific terms, p. 27

spanish_text: Los funcionarios que participaron en la inspección no encontraron pruebas suficientes para determinar quién había autorizado el traslado de los equipos.
errors_to_catch: commas added to a restrictive clause
why_this_chunk: A restrictive clause takes no commas; equipos = equipment; pruebas = evidence.
suggested_ok_english_hint: Which officials? The que-clause restricts. And equipos is uncountable in English.
english_key: The officials who took part in the inspection did not find enough evidence to determine who had authorized the transfer of the equipment.
acceptables: The officials who participated in the inspection did not find sufficient evidence to determine who had authorized the transfer of the equipment.
The officials who took part in the inspection found insufficient evidence to determine who had authorized the removal of the equipment.

traps.comment: The clause identifies which officials; it is restrictive, so no comma before who/that.
traps.label: commas added to a restrictive clause
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Restrictive and nonrestrictive clauses and appositives, p. 48

traps.comment: equipos (devices) = equipment, an uncountable noun. 'Equipments' is not English; 'teams' changes the meaning.
traps.label: equipos mistranslated
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: pruebas (investigation) = evidence. 'Proofs' or 'tests' changes the meaning.
traps.label: pruebas rendered as proofs / tests
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: Si se hubieran publicado los resultados a tiempo, las comunidades habrían podido evaluar el proyecto antes de que comenzaran las obras.
why_this_chunk: Third conditional: if + past perfect, would have + participle.
suggested_ok_english_hint: Si se hubieran publicado… habrían podido…: a past counterfactual. Which English conditional fits?
english_key: If the results had been published on time, the communities would have been able to evaluate the project before the work began.
acceptables: Had the results been published on time, the communities could have evaluated the project before construction began.
If the results had been published in time, the communities would have been able to assess the project before the work started.

detector.pattern: \bif the results would have\b|\bwould be able to evaluate\b|\bif the results were published\b

traps.comment: Past counterfactual: 'If the results had been published…, the communities would have been able to…'.
traps.ok: would have been able to evaluate
traps.label: broken third conditional
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Conditional tenses, p. 23

traps.comment: obras = construction / the work (mass noun). 'The works' is British or reads as 'everything'.
traps.label: obras rendered as the works
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Non-U.S. usage, p. 37

spanish_text: El comité no solo rechazó la solicitud inicial, sino que también exigió que se presentaran documentos adicionales antes del viernes.
why_this_chunk: Not only… but also joins two past verbs; mandative subjunctive after required that.
suggested_ok_english_hint: no solo… sino que también… exigió que + subjunctive. Where does 'not only' go, and which verb form follows 'required that'?
english_key: The committee not only rejected the initial application but also required that additional documents be submitted before Friday.
acceptables: The committee not only rejected the initial application but also required additional documents to be submitted before Friday.
The committee not only rejected the initial request but also demanded that additional documents be submitted by Friday.

detector.pattern: \bnot only the committee\b|\bbut (it )?also it\b|\bbut that it also\b

traps.comment: Place 'not only' directly before the first verb: not only rejected… but also required….
traps.label: misplaced not only
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Nonparallel constructions, p. 36

detector.pattern: \brequired that additional documents (were|are|should have been|would be) submitted\b

traps.comment: After required that…, US English uses the present (mandative) subjunctive: that X be…, that X identify…. The indicative is marked. 'should + verb' is also accepted.
traps.label: indicative after required that
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Subjunctive mood, p. 55

spanish_text: Según los expertos, una reducción de los costos no necesariamente se traducirá en un aumento inmediato de la demanda.
why_this_chunk: 'Will not necessarily' keeps the hedge; 'will necessarily not' says the opposite.
suggested_ok_english_hint: no necesariamente: what exactly does the negation cover?
english_key: According to experts, a reduction in costs will not necessarily translate into an immediate increase in demand.
acceptables: According to the experts, a reduction in costs will not necessarily result in an immediate increase in demand.
According to experts, lower costs will not necessarily translate into an immediate rise in demand.

detector.pattern: \bwill necessarily not\b|\bnecessarily will not\b|\bwill not translate\b|\bwill not result\b

traps.comment: no necesariamente = not necessarily (a hedge). 'Will necessarily not' or a flat 'will not' turns it into a denial.
traps.label: hedge became a denial
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: The hedge 'not necessarily' must survive.
traps.label: necesariamente omitted
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

spanish_text: Por mucho que insistan los proveedores, el municipio no modificará las condiciones del contrato mientras no se cumplan los requisitos legales.
why_this_chunk: Present tense after until for a future condition; Por mucho que = no matter how much.
suggested_ok_english_hint: mientras no se cumplan = until… are met. Which tense goes in that clause?
english_key: No matter how much the suppliers insist, the municipality will not modify the terms of the contract until the legal requirements are met.
acceptables: However much the suppliers insist, the municipality will not change the terms of the contract until the legal requirements have been met.
No matter how much the suppliers insist, the city will not modify the contract terms as long as the legal requirements are not met.

detector.pattern: \buntil the legal requirements (will be|are going to be)\b|\bno matter how much the suppliers will\b

traps.comment: Future time clauses take the present: 'until the requirements are met', 'no matter how much they insist'.
traps.ok: until the legal requirements are met
traps.no: until the legal requirements will be met
traps.label: future after until
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Verb tenses: Tense sequence in complex sentences referring to the future, p. 64

traps.comment: condiciones del contrato = terms of the contract.
traps.label: condiciones calqued
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: La entidad informó que únicamente se tramitarían las solicitudes presentadas dentro del plazo establecido en la nueva normativa.
why_this_chunk: Keep 'only' next to what it limits; tramitar = process.
suggested_ok_english_hint: únicamente restricts which applications. Where does 'only' go, and what is tramitar?
english_key: The agency reported that only applications submitted within the deadline set in the new regulations would be processed.
acceptables: The agency reported that only applications submitted within the deadline established in the new regulations would be processed.
The agency announced that it would process only those applications submitted within the time limit set by the new regulations.

traps.comment: únicamente limits the scope. Dropping 'only' turns a restriction into a general statement.
traps.label: únicamente omitted (only)
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: entidad (public body) = agency / office / institution. 'The entity' is stiff legalese in US English.
traps.label: entidad rendered as entity
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: tramitar = process / handle. And place 'only' before the noun it restricts, not before the verb.
traps.no: applications submitted would be processed only
traps.label: tramitar calqued or only misplaced
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Misplaced adverbs, p. 34

spanish_text: En lugar de reconocer el problema, la administración atribuyó las interrupciones del servicio a circunstancias que, según los vecinos, podían haberse evitado.
why_this_chunk: could have been avoided (past possibility); the 'according to residents' interrupter needs a pair of commas.
suggested_ok_english_hint: podían haberse evitado: which modal perfect? The comma pair interrupts a restrictive clause.
english_key: Instead of acknowledging the problem, the administration attributed the service interruptions to circumstances that, according to residents, could have been avoided.
acceptables: Rather than acknowledging the problem, the administration attributed the service interruptions to circumstances that, according to residents, could have been prevented.
Instead of admitting the problem, the administration blamed the service outages on circumstances that, according to local residents, could have been avoided.

traps.comment: podían haberse evitado = could have been avoided (passive, past). 'Could be avoided' moves it to the present.
traps.label: modal tense / voice wrong
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Verb tenses, p. 56

detector.pattern: \bthat according to residents,|\bthat, according to residents could\b

traps.comment: Set off the interrupter 'according to residents' with a pair of commas, or none.
traps.label: unbalanced commas
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

spanish_text: Tanto los docentes como los estudiantes deberán presentar una identificación válida para ingresar a las instalaciones durante las evaluaciones.
errors_to_catch: both… as well as / both… as
why_this_chunk: Both… and with a plural verb; evaluaciones (school) = exams; instalaciones = facilities.
suggested_ok_english_hint: Tanto… como… as a compound subject. Which pair is parallel? What are evaluaciones here?
english_key: Both teachers and students must present valid identification to enter the facilities during the exams.
acceptables: Both teachers and students will be required to show valid identification to enter the facilities during the examinations.
Both faculty and students must present valid ID to enter the premises during the exams.

traps.comment: tanto… como = both… and. 'Both… as well as' and 'both X as Y' are nonparallel.
traps.no: Both teachers as well as students
traps.label: both… as well as / both… as
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Nonparallel constructions, p. 36

traps.comment: instalaciones (building) = facilities / premises. 'Installations' is technical equipment.
traps.label: instalaciones rendered as installations
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: La decisión fue anunciada después de que se revisaran los documentos, pero no se explicó quién había solicitado la revisión.
why_this_chunk: Comma before 'but' joining two independent clauses; past perfect for earlier events.
suggested_ok_english_hint: Two clauses joined by pero. Keep the passive sense and the sequence of past events.
english_key: The decision was announced after the documents had been reviewed, but it was not explained who had requested the review.
acceptables: The decision was announced after the documents were reviewed, but no explanation was given as to who had requested the review.
The decision was announced after the documents had been reviewed, but there was no explanation of who had requested the review.

traps.comment: Two independent clauses need a conjunction (', but') or a semicolon; a bare comma is a comma splice.
traps.label: comma splice
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Run-on sentences / comma splices, p. 51

traps.comment: no se explicó: the negation must survive.
traps.label: negation omitted
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

spanish_text: Mientras que las ventas aumentaron en las principales ciudades, los ingresos de los pequeños comerciantes disminuyeron durante el mismo período.
why_this_chunk: Mientras que = while / whereas (contrast); ingresos = revenue / income.
suggested_ok_english_hint: Mientras que here is contrast, not time. Which English conjunction signals it?
english_key: While sales increased in the main cities, the revenue of small retailers decreased during the same period.
acceptables: While sales rose in the major cities, small retailers' income fell during the same period.
Whereas sales increased in the main cities, revenues for small businesses declined during the same period.

traps.comment: Mientras que contrasts two facts = while / whereas. 'Meanwhile' signals only time.
traps.label: mientras que rendered as meanwhile
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: ingresos (business) = revenue / income.
traps.label: ingresos mistranslated
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: No fue sino hasta que ocurrió una segunda falla cuando la compañía decidió reemplazar las piezas que había instalado el año anterior.
why_this_chunk: It was not until… that…; keep the past perfect for the earlier installation.
suggested_ok_english_hint: No fue sino hasta que… cuando…: a cleft meaning 'only then'. How does English mark it?
english_key: It was not until a second failure occurred that the company decided to replace the parts it had installed the previous year.
acceptables: It was not until a second failure occurred that the company decided to replace the parts it had installed the year before.
Only after a second failure occurred did the company decide to replace the parts it had installed the previous year.
It was only after a second failure that the company decided to replace the parts it had installed the previous year.

detector.pattern: ^\s*it was not (only )?until [^,]+ when\b|^\s*it was not but\b|\bwas not if not\b

traps.comment: No fue sino hasta que… cuando = It was not until… that…. 'It was not until… when' or 'was not but' garbles the cleft.
traps.label: not until cleft garbled
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: piezas (machine) = parts / components. 'Pieces' is too vague.
traps.label: piezas rendered as pieces
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: había instalado (earlier past) = had installed.
traps.label: past perfect lost
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Verb tenses, p. 56

spanish_text: Aunque nadie puso en duda la importancia del programa, algunos especialistas advirtieron que su ejecución podría resultar más costosa de lo previsto.
why_this_chunk: advertir = warn; ejecución = implementation (not execution).
suggested_ok_english_hint: advirtieron que = warned. What does ejecución mean for a program?
english_key: Although no one questioned the importance of the program, some specialists warned that implementing it could prove more costly than expected.
acceptables: Although nobody questioned the importance of the program, some experts warned that its implementation might prove more expensive than anticipated.
Although no one doubted the importance of the program, some specialists warned that carrying it out could end up costing more than expected.

traps.comment: advertir = warn / caution. 'Advise' means recommend; the warning disappears.
traps.label: advertir rendered as advise
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: ejecución de un programa = implementation. 'Execution' suggests a death sentence or computer code.
traps.label: ejecución rendered as execution
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: US target: program, not programme.
traps.label: programme (non-US spelling)
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Non-U.S. usage, p. 37

spanish_text: Los resultados indican que la mayoría de los participantes estaba satisfecha, aunque una parte considerable manifestó no haber recibido la orientación prometida.
errors_to_catch: singular verb with majority of + plural
why_this_chunk: With 'most of the participants' / 'the majority of participants', English uses a plural verb; keep the negation in no haber recibido.
suggested_ok_english_hint: la mayoría… estaba satisfecha: singular in Spanish. What does English agreement follow?
english_key: The results indicate that most of the participants were satisfied, although a considerable number said that they had not received the guidance they had been promised.
acceptables: The results indicate that the majority of participants were satisfied, although a considerable proportion said they had not received the promised guidance.
The results show that most participants were satisfied, although a significant portion reported not having received the guidance that had been promised.

traps.comment: With a plural of-phrase (participants), 'the majority / most' takes a plural verb in US English.
traps.label: singular verb with majority of + plural
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Collective and mass nouns, pp. 15-16

traps.comment: no haber recibido: the negation must survive.
traps.label: negation omitted
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: orientación (help) = guidance / advice. 'Orientation' is an introductory session.
traps.label: orientación rendered as orientation
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: Antes de que se apruebe cualquier modificación, deberán consultarse las observaciones formuladas por las organizaciones que participaron en el proceso.
errors_to_catch: commas added to a restrictive clause
why_this_chunk: Present tense after before; restrictive 'that participated' with no comma; US 'organizations'.
suggested_ok_english_hint: Antes de que se apruebe (future reference): which tense in English? Which organizations?
english_key: Before any modification is approved, the comments made by the organizations that participated in the process must be considered.
acceptables: Before any change is approved, the comments made by the organizations that took part in the process must be consulted.
Before any amendment is approved, the observations submitted by the organizations that participated in the process will have to be reviewed.

traps.comment: After before in future contexts, English uses the present: 'before any modification is approved'.
traps.label: future after before
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Verb tenses: Tense sequence in complex sentences referring to the future, p. 64

traps.comment: US target: organizations, not organisations.
traps.label: organisations (non-US spelling)
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Non-U.S. usage, p. 37

traps.comment: The clause identifies which organizations; it is restrictive, so no comma before who/that.
traps.label: commas added to a restrictive clause
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Restrictive and nonrestrictive clauses and appositives, p. 48

spanish_text: La medida pretende no solo mejorar el acceso a los servicios, sino también garantizar que estos se presten en condiciones de igualdad.
why_this_chunk: pretender = seek / aim; not only to… but also to… is parallel.
suggested_ok_english_hint: pretende = seeks / aims. no solo… sino también… joins two infinitives.
english_key: The measure seeks not only to improve access to services but also to ensure that they are provided on an equal basis.
acceptables: The measure aims not only to improve access to services but also to guarantee that they are provided on equal terms.
The measure is intended not only to improve access to services but also to ensure that these are delivered equitably.

traps.comment: pretender = seek / aim / intend. 'Pretend' means feign.
traps.label: pretender rendered as pretend
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

detector.pattern: \bnot only to improve [^.]*\bbut also (guarantee|ensure|guaranteeing|ensuring)\b|\bnot only improve [^.]*\bbut also to\b

traps.comment: Match the halves: not only to improve… but also to ensure….
traps.label: nonparallel halves
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Nonparallel constructions, p. 36

spanish_text: Si bien las recomendaciones parecen razonables, ninguna de ellas podrá aplicarse mientras no se asignen los recursos correspondientes.
errors_to_catch: si bien rendered as if / even if
why_this_chunk: si bien = although / while; ninguna = none (negation); present after until.
suggested_ok_english_hint: Si bien = although (a fact). mientras no se asignen = until… are allocated.
english_key: While the recommendations seem reasonable, none of them can be implemented until the corresponding resources have been allocated.
acceptables: Although the recommendations seem reasonable, none of them can be implemented until the necessary resources are allocated.
While the recommendations appear reasonable, none of them can be applied until the corresponding funds have been allocated.

traps.comment: si bien = although / while (a concession of fact). 'Even if' or 'if' turns a fact into a hypothesis.
traps.label: si bien rendered as if / even if
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: ninguna de ellas = none of them. The negation must survive.
traps.label: ninguna lost
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: recursos (budget) = resources / funds. 'Appeals' is the legal sense.
traps.label: recursos mistranslated
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: De los tres informes presentados, solo uno contenía datos que permitieran comparar los resultados obtenidos en las distintas regiones.
why_this_chunk: only + one; permitir needs an object (made it possible to / allowed X to).
suggested_ok_english_hint: solo uno: the restriction must survive. permitieran needs an object in English.
english_key: Of the three reports submitted, only one contained data that made it possible to compare the results obtained in the different regions.
acceptables: Of the three reports submitted, only one contained data that allowed the results obtained in the different regions to be compared.
Of the three reports presented, just one contained data that would allow a comparison of the results obtained in the various regions.

traps.comment: solo limits the scope. Dropping 'only' turns a restriction into a general statement.
traps.label: solo omitted (only)
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: permitir + infinitive: English needs an object (allowed X to…, made it possible to…). 'Allowed to verb' with no object is ungrammatical.
traps.label: allow to + verb without object
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

spanish_text: La empresa afirmó que había cumplido sus obligaciones; sin embargo, los documentos disponibles no permitían verificar esa afirmación.
why_this_chunk: However as a conjunctive adverb between clauses: semicolon before, comma after; US 'fulfilled'.
suggested_ok_english_hint: ; sin embargo, — keep the semicolon. Which spelling of 'fulfill' is US?
english_key: The company stated that it had fulfilled its obligations; however, the available documents did not make it possible to verify that claim.
acceptables: The company stated that it had met its obligations; however, the documents available did not allow that claim to be verified.
The company claimed that it had fulfilled its obligations; however, the available documents did not make it possible to verify that statement.

traps.comment: 'However' joining two independent clauses needs a semicolon (or period) before it; a comma creates a splice.
traps.label: comma splice before however
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Commas: Conjunctive adverbs, p. 18

traps.comment: permitir + infinitive: English needs an object (allowed X to…, made it possible to…). 'Allowed to verb' with no object is ungrammatical.
traps.ok: did not make it possible to verify
traps.label: allow to + verb without object
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

spanish_text: A medida que aumenta el número de usuarios, se hace más difícil mantener la calidad del servicio sin contratar personal adicional.
why_this_chunk: 'The number of' takes a singular verb; personal = staff.
suggested_ok_english_hint: 'The number of users' + verb: singular or plural?
english_key: As the number of users increases, it becomes more difficult to maintain the quality of the service without hiring additional staff.
acceptables: As the number of users grows, it becomes harder to maintain service quality without hiring more staff.
As the number of users increases, maintaining the quality of the service becomes more difficult without hiring additional personnel.

traps.comment: 'The number of…' takes a singular verb (increases).
traps.label: agreement with the number of
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Collective and mass nouns, pp. 15-16

traps.comment: personal = staff / personnel. 'Personal' is the adjective.
traps.label: personal rendered as personal
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: No se trata de determinar quién cometió el error, sino de establecer por qué los controles existentes no permitieron detectarlo.
why_this_chunk: Not X but Y with matching forms; 'did not allow to detect' lacks an object.
suggested_ok_english_hint: No se trata de… sino de…: which English frame contrasts two infinitives? What does permitir need?
english_key: The point is not to determine who made the mistake but to establish why the existing controls failed to detect it.
acceptables: The aim is not to determine who made the error but to establish why the existing controls did not detect it.
It is not a matter of determining who made the mistake but of establishing why the existing controls did not allow it to be detected.

detector.pattern: \bmistake,? (if not|but rather it is)\b|\berror,? if not\b|\bnot to determine [^.]*\bbut establishing\b

traps.comment: no… sino = not… but. Keep the two halves in the same form (to determine… to establish).
traps.label: sino mistranslated / nonparallel
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Nonparallel constructions, p. 36

traps.comment: permitir + infinitive: English needs an object (allowed X to…, made it possible to…). 'Allowed to verb' with no object is ungrammatical.
traps.label: allow to + verb without object
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

detector.pattern: ^\s*it is not treated\b|^\s*it does not treat\b

traps.comment: No se trata de = The point is not / It is not a matter of. 'It is not treated' is a calque.
traps.label: se trata de calqued
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Idioms, p. 31

spanish_text: Los representantes solicitaron que el plazo se ampliara y que se notificara por escrito la decisión a todos los interesados.
why_this_chunk: Mandative subjunctive in both that-clauses; interesados = interested parties.
suggested_ok_english_hint: solicitaron que… y que…: two parallel subjunctive clauses. Which verb form follows 'requested that'?
english_key: The representatives requested that the deadline be extended and that all interested parties be notified of the decision in writing.
acceptables: The representatives requested that the deadline be extended and that the decision be communicated in writing to all interested parties.
The representatives asked for the deadline to be extended and for all interested parties to be notified of the decision in writing.

detector.pattern: \brequested that the deadline (was|is|would be) extended\b|\band that all interested parties (were|are|would be) notified\b

traps.comment: After requested that…, US English uses the present (mandative) subjunctive: that X be…, that X identify…. The indicative is marked. 'should + verb' is also accepted.
traps.label: indicative after requested that
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Subjunctive mood, p. 55

traps.comment: los interesados (legal) = interested parties / those concerned.
traps.label: interesados left as an adjective
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: Aun cuando el presupuesto fuera aprobado mañana, las obras no comenzarían hasta que la autoridad ambiental expidiera la autorización correspondiente.
why_this_chunk: even if + were (past subjunctive), would…; until + past in a hypothetical sequence.
suggested_ok_english_hint: Aun cuando + fuera: hypothetical. Which English form, and which tense after until?
english_key: Even if the budget were approved tomorrow, the work would not begin until the environmental authority issued the corresponding permit.
acceptables: Even if the budget were approved tomorrow, construction would not begin until the environmental authority had issued the corresponding authorization.
Even if the budget were approved tomorrow, the work would not start until the environmental agency issued the relevant permit.

traps.comment: A hypothetical: 'even if the budget were approved…, the work would…'. The indicative breaks the hypothetical frame.
traps.label: indicative in a hypothetical
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Subjunctive mood, p. 55

traps.comment: Aun cuando + imperfect subjunctive = even if (hypothetical), not 'even when' or 'although'.
traps.label: aun cuando mistranslated
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: No 'would' in the until-clause: 'until the authority issued'.
traps.no: until the environmental authority would issue
traps.label: conditional in a time clause
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Verb tenses: Tense sequence in complex sentences referring to the future, p. 64

spanish_text: Las personas que presentaron reclamaciones antes del cierre del proceso recibirán una respuesta, siempre que hayan aportado la documentación requerida.
errors_to_catch: siempre que rendered as always / whenever
commas added to a restrictive clause
why_this_chunk: Restrictive who-clause (no comma); siempre que = provided that.
suggested_ok_english_hint: Which people? And siempre que + subjunctive: condition or frequency?
english_key: People who filed complaints before the process closed will receive a response, provided that they have submitted the required documentation.
acceptables: Those who filed claims before the close of the process will receive a response, provided that they have provided the required documentation.
People who submitted complaints before the process ended will receive a reply as long as they have submitted the required documents.

traps.comment: siempre que / siempre y cuando + subjunctive = provided that / as long as. It is a condition, not 'always' or 'whenever'.
traps.label: siempre que rendered as always / whenever
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: reclamación = complaint / claim. 'Reclamation' means recovering land or materials.
traps.label: reclamación rendered as reclamation
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: The clause identifies which people; it is restrictive, so no comma before who/that.
traps.label: commas added to a restrictive clause
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Restrictive and nonrestrictive clauses and appositives, p. 48

spanish_text: El Ministerio publicó una guía para explicar qué cambios entrarían en vigor, a quiénes afectarían y cómo deberían aplicarse.
why_this_chunk: whom as the object of affect; parallel embedded questions; entrar en vigor = take effect.
suggested_ok_english_hint: a quiénes afectarían: object of affect. who or whom? Three parallel questions.
english_key: The Ministry published a guide to explain which changes would take effect, whom they would affect, and how they should be applied.
acceptables: The Ministry published a guide explaining what changes would take effect, whom they would affect, and how they should be implemented.
The Ministry published a guide to explain which changes would come into force, who would be affected by them, and how they were to be applied.

traps.comment: 'They would affect whom' — the pronoun is the object, so formal English requires whom.
traps.label: who used as an object
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Who and whom, p. 64

traps.comment: entrar en vigor = take effect / come into force. 'Enter into vigor' is not US English.
traps.label: entrar en vigor calqued
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: Después de revisar las cifras, la comisión concluyó que los gastos habían aumentado más rápidamente de lo que se había previsto.
why_this_chunk: The introductory phrase must attach to the commission; cifras = figures.
suggested_ok_english_hint: Después de revisar: who reviewed? Make sure the subject after the comma is the one doing it.
english_key: After reviewing the figures, the commission concluded that spending had increased more rapidly than expected.
acceptables: After reviewing the figures, the commission concluded that expenditures had risen faster than had been anticipated.
After reviewing the numbers, the commission concluded that expenses had increased more quickly than had been expected.

traps.comment: cifras = figures / numbers. 'Ciphers' are codes.
traps.label: cifras rendered as ciphers
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: After reviewing… must be followed by the reviewer (the commission). Otherwise the modifier dangles.
traps.ok: After reviewing the figures, the commission
traps.no: After reviewing the figures, it was concluded by the commission
traps.label: dangling introductory phrase
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Dangling modifiers, p. 25

spanish_text: Cualquier persona que desee acceder al beneficio deberá demostrar que cumple los requisitos y que no recibe una ayuda equivalente.
why_this_chunk: Parallel that-clauses; 'they' as a gender-neutral singular; keep 'not'.
suggested_ok_english_hint: deberá demostrar que… y que no…: two parallel that-clauses. Keep the negation in the second.
english_key: Anyone who wishes to access the benefit must prove that they meet the requirements and that they are not receiving equivalent assistance.
acceptables: Anyone who wishes to obtain the benefit must demonstrate that they meet the requirements and that they do not receive equivalent aid.
Any person wishing to access the benefit must show that they meet the requirements and are not receiving equivalent assistance.

traps.comment: que no recibe una ayuda equivalente: the negation must survive.
traps.label: negation omitted
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: Cualquier persona: avoid a generic 'he'. Use they or recast.
traps.label: generic he
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, He/she and gender-specific terms, p. 27

spanish_text: En cuanto a las denuncias recibidas, la oficina aclaró que algunas ya habían sido resueltas y otras continuaban bajo investigación.
why_this_chunk: Past perfect for already resolved; denuncias = complaints.
suggested_ok_english_hint: algunas… y otras…: two parallel clauses. Keep the tense sequence.
english_key: Regarding the complaints received, the office clarified that some had already been resolved and that others were still under investigation.
acceptables: With regard to the complaints received, the office clarified that some had already been resolved and others remained under investigation.
As for the complaints that had been received, the office explained that some had already been resolved while others were still being investigated.

traps.comment: denuncias = complaints / reports. 'Denunciations' are public condemnations.
traps.label: denuncias rendered as denunciations
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: habían sido resueltas = had been resolved (earlier past).
traps.label: past perfect lost
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Verb tenses, p. 56

spanish_text: El proyecto, cuyo costo inicial se estimó en veinte millones de pesos, podría requerir una inversión adicional si se amplía su alcance.
why_this_chunk: Nonrestrictive whose-clause in commas; present tense after if (not 'will').
suggested_ok_english_hint: cuyo = whose; si se amplía (present) for a future possibility. Which tense after if?
english_key: The project, whose initial cost was estimated at twenty million pesos, could require additional investment if its scope is expanded.
acceptables: The project, whose initial cost was estimated at 20 million pesos, might require additional investment if its scope is broadened.
The project, the initial cost of which was estimated at twenty million pesos, could require additional investment if its scope is expanded.

traps.comment: The project is already identified; the clause is nonrestrictive and must be set off by commas (not dashes).
traps.label: nonrestrictive commas missing
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Restrictive and nonrestrictive clauses and appositives, p. 48

traps.comment: No 'will' in the if-clause: 'if its scope is expanded'.
traps.no: if its scope will be expanded
traps.label: future in an if-clause
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Verb tenses: Tense sequence in complex sentences referring to the future, p. 64

spanish_text: A menos que el contratista entregue los informes pendientes, la entidad no podrá certificar que las actividades se ejecutaron conforme a lo acordado.
why_this_chunk: Present after unless; ejecutarse = be carried out.
suggested_ok_english_hint: A menos que + subjunctive (future): which tense after unless? And ejecutar actividades?
english_key: Unless the contractor delivers the outstanding reports, the agency will not be able to certify that the activities were carried out as agreed.
acceptables: Unless the contractor submits the pending reports, the agency will not be able to certify that the activities were performed as agreed.
Unless the contractor delivers the outstanding reports, the agency cannot certify that the activities were carried out in accordance with the agreement.

traps.comment: No 'will' after unless: 'unless the contractor delivers'.
traps.label: future after unless
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Verb tenses: Tense sequence in complex sentences referring to the future, p. 64

traps.comment: entidad (public body) = agency / office / institution. 'The entity' is stiff legalese in US English.
traps.label: entidad rendered as entity
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: ejecutarse (actividades) = be carried out / performed.
traps.label: ejecutar rendered as execute
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: Las autoridades aseguraron que el servicio volvería a funcionar con normalidad, pero evitaron precisar cuándo ocurriría.
why_this_chunk: evitar precisar = avoided specifying / declined to say; precisar = specify.
suggested_ok_english_hint: aseguraron que… pero evitaron precisar…: what does evitar + inf. mean here, and precisar?
english_key: The authorities assured the public that the service would return to normal but declined to specify when that would happen.
acceptables: The authorities gave assurances that the service would resume normal operation but avoided specifying when that would occur.
The authorities stated that the service would soon be operating normally again but would not say exactly when.

traps.comment: evitar + inf. = avoid + -ing (avoided specifying). 'Avoided to specify' is ungrammatical.
traps.label: avoid + to-infinitive
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: precisar here = specify / state exactly, not 'need'.
traps.label: precisar mistranslated
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: No solo se desconocía el número exacto de afectados, sino que tampoco existía un registro actualizado de las solicitudes recibidas.
errors_to_catch: no inversion after fronted Not only
why_this_chunk: Not only + inversion (was the number…); tampoco becomes 'also no'.
suggested_ok_english_hint: No solo… sino que tampoco…: fronted 'Not only' needs inversion. How do you keep the second negation?
english_key: Not only was the exact number of people affected unknown, but there was also no up-to-date record of the applications received.
acceptables: Not only was the exact number of those affected unknown, but there was also no updated record of the applications received.
Not only was the exact number of affected people unknown; there was also no up-to-date register of the applications that had been received.

traps.comment: A fronted 'Not only' requires subject–auxiliary inversion: 'Not only was the exact number… unknown'.
traps.ok: Not only was the exact number
traps.no: Not only the exact number was
traps.label: no inversion after fronted Not only
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Nonparallel constructions, p. 36

traps.comment: tampoco existía = there was also no…. The second negation must survive.
traps.ok: there was also no up-to-date record
traps.no: there was also an up-to-date record
traps.label: tampoco lost
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: 'The number of…' takes a singular verb.
traps.ok: the exact number of people affected unknown
traps.no: the exact number of people affected were unknown
traps.label: agreement with the number of
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Collective and mass nouns, pp. 15-16

spanish_text: El hecho de que la norma haya sido modificada no significa que las obligaciones anteriores hayan dejado de ser exigibles.
why_this_chunk: The double structure 'does not mean… are no longer' keeps both meanings; exigible = enforceable.
suggested_ok_english_hint: haya dejado de ser exigibles: two negations overlap. What does exigible mean?
english_key: The fact that the regulation has been amended does not mean that the previous obligations are no longer enforceable.
acceptables: The fact that the rule has been amended does not mean that the earlier obligations have ceased to be enforceable.
The fact that the regulation has been modified does not mean that prior obligations are no longer enforceable.

traps.comment: exigibles (legal) = enforceable.
traps.label: exigible calqued
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: dejar de ser = no longer / cease to be. Without it, the sentence says the opposite.
traps.label: dejar de omitted
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

spanish_text: Mientras los técnicos reparaban el sistema, los usuarios recibían mensajes que indicaban que el servicio se restablecería en pocas horas.
why_this_chunk: Mientras = while (time); backshifted 'would be restored'.
suggested_ok_english_hint: Here mientras is time (simultaneous). Which future-in-the-past form follows 'indicating that'?
english_key: While the technicians were repairing the system, users received messages indicating that service would be restored within a few hours.
acceptables: While the technicians were repairing the system, users were receiving messages saying that the service would be restored in a few hours.
While technicians repaired the system, users received messages stating that service would be restored within a few hours.

traps.comment: Reported in the past: se restablecería = would be restored.
traps.label: tense sequence broken
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Verb tenses, p. 56

traps.comment: técnicos = technicians.
traps.label: técnicos mistranslated
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: La empresa ofreció devolver el dinero o sustituir el producto, siempre y cuando el cliente conservara el comprobante de compra.
errors_to_catch: siempre que rendered as always / whenever
why_this_chunk: siempre y cuando = provided that; comprobante de compra = receipt / proof of purchase.
suggested_ok_english_hint: siempre y cuando = provided that. What is a comprobante de compra?
english_key: The company offered to refund the money or replace the product, provided that the customer kept the proof of purchase.
acceptables: The company offered to refund the money or exchange the product as long as the customer had kept the receipt.
The company offered to give a refund or replace the product, provided that the customer kept the proof of purchase.

traps.comment: siempre que / siempre y cuando + subjunctive = provided that / as long as. It is a condition, not 'always' or 'whenever'.
traps.label: siempre que rendered as always / whenever
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: comprobante de compra = receipt / proof of purchase.
traps.label: comprobante mistranslated
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: Keep both offers as infinitives: to refund… or replace….
traps.label: nonparallel pair
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Nonparallel constructions, p. 36

spanish_text: De haberse realizado una inspección adicional, probablemente se habrían identificado las fallas antes de que el edificio fuera ocupado.
errors_to_catch: De haberse calqued as of having
why_this_chunk: Had… been carried out / If… had been; realizar ≠ realize.
suggested_ok_english_hint: De haberse realizado… se habrían identificado: a past counterfactual. Which conditional? What is realizar?
english_key: Had an additional inspection been carried out, the defects would probably have been identified before the building was occupied.
acceptables: If an additional inspection had been conducted, the defects would probably have been detected before the building was occupied.
Had an additional inspection been performed, the flaws would likely have been identified before the building was occupied.

traps.comment: De + perfect infinitive = If… had… / Had…. 'Of having' is a word-for-word calque.
traps.ok: Had an additional inspection been carried out
traps.no: Of having carried out an additional inspection
traps.label: De haberse calqued as of having
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Conditional tenses, p. 23

traps.comment: realizar = carry out / conduct / make. 'Realize' means to become aware of something.
traps.label: realizar rendered as realize
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: fallas (building) = defects / flaws. 'Failures' suggests a collapse.
traps.label: fallas rendered as failures
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: Quienes no estén de acuerdo con la decisión podrán solicitar su revisión dentro de los diez días siguientes a la notificación.
focus: Present in a generic relative clause
why_this_chunk: Present tense for a future generic; 'may' (podrán) expresses permission.
suggested_ok_english_hint: Quienes no estén de acuerdo (future reference): which tense? Keep the negation.
english_key: Those who disagree with the decision may request a review within ten days of notification.
acceptables: Those who do not agree with the decision may request its review within ten days after notification.
Anyone who disagrees with the decision may request a review within ten days following the notification.

traps.comment: English uses the present in this generic future clause: 'those who disagree'.
traps.pitfall: Present in a generic relative clause
traps.label: future in the relative clause
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Verb tenses: Tense sequence in complex sentences referring to the future, p. 64

traps.comment: no estén de acuerdo = disagree. The negation must survive.
traps.label: negation lost
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

spanish_text: El director explicó que la disminución de los ingresos se debía principalmente a la suspensión temporal de varios contratos.
why_this_chunk: Keep the adverb next to what it qualifies (mainly due to); ingresos = revenue.
suggested_ok_english_hint: se debía principalmente a: where does 'mainly' go?
english_key: The director explained that the drop in revenue was mainly due to the temporary suspension of several contracts.
acceptables: The director explained that the decrease in income was mainly due to the temporary suspension of several contracts.
The director explained that the decline in revenue was primarily the result of the temporary suspension of several contracts.

traps.comment: ingresos = revenue / income.
traps.label: ingresos mistranslated
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: principalmente modifies the cause, not the explaining: 'was mainly due to'.
traps.label: misplaced adverb
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Misplaced adverbs, p. 34

spanish_text: Aunque los datos son preliminares, permiten identificar tendencias que podrían resultar útiles para orientar decisiones futuras.
why_this_chunk: 'Data are' in formal register; 'allow to identify' lacks an object.
suggested_ok_english_hint: permiten identificar: permit needs an object. Is 'data' singular or plural here?
english_key: Although the data are preliminary, they make it possible to identify trends that could be useful in guiding future decisions.
acceptables: Although the data are preliminary, they allow trends to be identified that could prove useful for guiding future decisions.
Although the data are preliminary, they reveal trends that could be useful in shaping future decisions.

traps.comment: permitir + infinitive: English needs an object (allowed X to…, made it possible to…). 'Allowed to verb' with no object is ungrammatical.
traps.label: allow to + verb without object
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: resultar útiles = prove / turn out to be useful. 'Result useful' is a calque.
traps.label: resultar calqued
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: Entre las medidas propuestas figuraban la contratación de nuevos empleados, la actualización de los equipos y la mejora de los procedimientos internos.
why_this_chunk: Parallel series (all gerunds or all nouns); equipos = equipment.
suggested_ok_english_hint: A three-item series of nouns. Keep one form throughout. What is equipos?
english_key: The proposed measures included hiring new employees, upgrading equipment, and improving internal procedures.
acceptables: Among the proposed measures were hiring new employees, updating the equipment, and improving internal procedures.
The measures proposed included the hiring of new employees, the upgrading of equipment, and the improvement of internal procedures.

detector.pattern: \bhiring new employees, (the update|the upgrade|to update|update the)\b|\band to improve internal\b

traps.comment: Keep one form: hiring…, upgrading…, and improving… (or three nouns).
traps.label: mixed forms in the series
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Nonparallel constructions, p. 36

traps.comment: equipos (devices) = equipment, an uncountable noun. 'Equipments' is not English; 'teams' changes the meaning.
traps.label: equipos mistranslated
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: La información publicada en el portal no coincide con la que se entregó a los participantes durante la reunión del mes pasado.
why_this_chunk: Repeat the noun or use 'what' so the referent of la que is clear.
suggested_ok_english_hint: la que se entregó: what does 'la' refer back to? Keep the referent clear.
english_key: The information posted on the portal does not match the information given to participants during last month's meeting.
acceptables: The information published on the portal does not match what was provided to the participants at last month's meeting.
The information posted on the website does not coincide with the information that was given to participants during the meeting last month.

traps.comment: la que = the information that. 'The one' blurs the referent with a mass noun.
traps.label: vague referent
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Anaphora / Referents, p. 8

traps.comment: no coincide: the negation must survive.
traps.label: negation omitted
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

spanish_text: Por un lado, el nuevo sistema facilitaría el acceso a los expedientes; por otro, obligaría a invertir en capacitación y seguridad.
why_this_chunk: On the one hand…; on the other…: parallel clauses separated by a semicolon.
suggested_ok_english_hint: Por un lado…; por otro… Keep the semicolon. What are expedientes and capacitación?
english_key: On the one hand, the new system would facilitate access to case files; on the other, it would require investment in training and security.
acceptables: On the one hand, the new system would make it easier to access records; on the other hand, it would require investment in training and security.
On the one hand, the new system would facilitate access to files; on the other, it would make it necessary to invest in training and security.

traps.comment: expedientes = case files / records. 'Expedient' is a means to an end.
traps.label: expediente rendered as expedient
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: capacitación = training.
traps.label: capacitación calqued
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

detector.pattern: \bcase files, on the other\b|\bfiles, on the other\b|\brecords, on the other\b

traps.comment: Two independent clauses: keep the semicolon before 'on the other'. A comma alone makes a splice.
traps.label: comma splice
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Run-on sentences / comma splices, p. 51

spanish_text: La asociación negó haber autorizado la publicación del documento y pidió que se retirara hasta que se aclarara su origen.
why_this_chunk: denied + -ing; mandative subjunctive after requested that; no 'would' after until.
suggested_ok_english_hint: negó haber… y pidió que se retirara: which form follows 'requested that'?
english_key: The association denied having authorized the publication of the document and requested that it be withdrawn until its origin was clarified.
acceptables: The association denied that it had authorized publication of the document and asked for it to be withdrawn until its origin had been clarified.
The association denied having authorized the publication of the document and requested that it be taken down until its origin was clarified.

traps.comment: After requested that…, US English uses the present (mandative) subjunctive: that X be…, that X identify…. The indicative is marked. 'should + verb' is also accepted.
traps.label: indicative after requested that
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Subjunctive mood, p. 55

traps.comment: negar haber = deny having (gerund).
traps.label: deny + to-infinitive
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

spanish_text: En caso de que se produzcan cambios en el cronograma, la entidad deberá comunicar las nuevas fechas a los interesados.
why_this_chunk: Present after if; cronograma = schedule / timeline.
suggested_ok_english_hint: En caso de que + subjunctive (future): which tense after 'if'? What is cronograma?
english_key: If there are changes to the schedule, the agency must communicate the new dates to the interested parties.
acceptables: In the event of changes to the schedule, the agency must notify the interested parties of the new dates.
Should there be any changes in the timeline, the agency will have to inform those concerned of the new dates.

detector.pattern: \bif there will be\b|\bin case there will be\b

traps.comment: No 'will' in the if-clause: 'If there are changes…'.
traps.label: future in an if-clause
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Verb tenses: Tense sequence in complex sentences referring to the future, p. 64

traps.comment: cronograma = schedule / timeline.
traps.label: cronograma rendered as chronogram
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: entidad (public body) = agency / office / institution. 'The entity' is stiff legalese in US English.
traps.label: entidad rendered as entity
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: El secretario señaló que no habían recibido suficientes propuestas para evaluar todas las alternativas que exigía la convocatoria.
errors_to_catch: singular he for a plural verb
why_this_chunk: The plural verb implies the office; a passive or 'they' avoids inventing a subject; convocatoria = call for proposals.
suggested_ok_english_hint: Ambiguous source: singular secretario + plural habían recibido. Who received the proposals?
english_key: The secretary noted that not enough proposals had been received to evaluate all the alternatives required by the call for proposals.
acceptables: The secretary pointed out that they had not received enough proposals to evaluate all of the alternatives required by the call for proposals.
The secretary noted that not enough proposals had been received to assess all the options required under the call for bids.

traps.comment: convocatoria = call for applications / proposals / bids. A convocation is a ceremony or assembly.
traps.label: convocatoria rendered as convocation
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: no habían recibido suficientes: the negation must survive.
traps.label: negation omitted
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

detector.pattern: \bthat he had not received\b|\bthat he had received\b

traps.comment: The verb is plural (habían recibido), so 'he' misreads the source. Use a passive or 'they' (the office).
traps.ok: not enough proposals had been received
traps.no: he had not received enough proposals
traps.label: singular he for a plural verb
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Grammatical ambiguity in the source language, p. 26

spanish_text: A diferencia de las empresas más grandes, los pequeños negocios suelen tener dificultades para acceder a créditos en condiciones favorables.
why_this_chunk: soler = often / tend to; US 'favorable'; comparison must set companies against businesses.
suggested_ok_english_hint: A diferencia de… compares two groups. What does suelen add, and how is favorable spelled in US English?
english_key: Unlike larger companies, small businesses often have difficulty obtaining credit on favorable terms.
acceptables: Unlike larger companies, small businesses tend to have difficulty accessing credit on favorable terms.
Unlike bigger firms, small businesses usually find it difficult to obtain loans on favorable terms.

traps.comment: US target: favorable, not favourable.
traps.label: favourable (non-US spelling)
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Non-U.S. usage, p. 37

traps.comment: suelen = often / tend to. Dropping it turns a tendency into an absolute.
traps.label: suelen omitted
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: en condiciones favorables (credit) = on favorable terms.
traps.label: condiciones calqued
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: La presidenta recordó que los acuerdos suscritos durante la reunión anterior seguían vigentes, aunque todavía no se hubieran ejecutado.
why_this_chunk: recordar (announce) = note / point out; vigente = in effect; no gender added.
suggested_ok_english_hint: recordó here is not 'remembered'. vigentes = ? Does presidenta need 'female'?
english_key: The president noted that the agreements signed at the previous meeting remained in effect, even though they had not yet been implemented.
acceptables: The president pointed out that the agreements reached at the previous meeting were still in force, even though they had not yet been carried out.
The chair recalled that the agreements signed during the previous meeting remained valid, although they had not yet been implemented.

traps.comment: recordó que (speaking to others) = noted / pointed out / reminded everyone. 'Remembered' is an internal act.
traps.label: recordó rendered as remembered
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: vigente / entrar en vigor = in effect / in force / take effect. 'Vigent' and 'vigor' are not US legal English here.
traps.label: vigente rendered as vigent / vigor
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: La presidenta: 'president' is neutral in English; don't add gender.
traps.label: gender added
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, He/she and gender-specific terms, p. 27

spanish_text: No cabe duda de que la inversión es necesaria; lo que sigue sin estar claro es quién asumirá los costos adicionales.
why_this_chunk: Semicolon between independent clauses; sigue sin estar claro = remains unclear.
suggested_ok_english_hint: Keep the semicolon between the two clauses. What does sigue sin estar claro mean?
english_key: There is no doubt that the investment is necessary; what remains unclear is who will bear the additional costs.
acceptables: There is no doubt that the investment is needed; what is still unclear is who will cover the additional costs.
The investment is undoubtedly necessary; what remains unclear is who will assume the additional costs.

traps.comment: Two independent clauses: use a semicolon or a period; a comma alone is a splice.
traps.label: comma splice
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Run-on sentences / comma splices, p. 51

traps.comment: sigue sin estar claro = remains unclear. Dropping the negation reverses the meaning.
traps.label: sin (negation) lost
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

spanish_text: Por más que el informe destaque los avances, resulta difícil ignorar las deficiencias que señalaron los evaluadores externos.
why_this_chunk: Por más que = no matter how much; resultar = be / prove; deficiencias = shortcomings.
suggested_ok_english_hint: Por más que = however much. resulta difícil = it is difficult. Who pointed out the shortcomings?
english_key: However much the report highlights the progress made, it is difficult to ignore the shortcomings pointed out by the external evaluators.
acceptables: No matter how much the report emphasizes the progress made, it is hard to ignore the deficiencies identified by the external evaluators.
Although the report highlights the progress that has been made, it is difficult to overlook the shortcomings noted by the external reviewers.

detector.pattern: ^\s*(for more that|for more than|by more that)\b

traps.comment: Por más que = however much / no matter how much. 'For more that' is a calque.
traps.label: por más que calqued
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Idioms, p. 31

traps.comment: resulta difícil = it is difficult. 'It results difficult' is a calque.
traps.label: resultar calqued
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: El tribunal ordenó que los pagos suspendidos se reanudaran una vez que se verificara la identidad de los beneficiarios.
why_this_chunk: Mandative subjunctive after ordered that; una vez que = once.
suggested_ok_english_hint: ordenó que + subjunctive. Which verb form follows 'ordered that'?
english_key: The court ordered that the suspended payments be resumed once the identity of the beneficiaries had been verified.
acceptables: The court ordered that the suspended payments be resumed once the beneficiaries' identity had been verified.
The court ordered the suspended payments to be resumed once the identity of the beneficiaries was verified.

detector.pattern: \bordered that the suspended payments (were|would be|are|should have been) resumed\b

traps.comment: After ordered that…, US English uses the present (mandative) subjunctive: that X be…, that X identify…. The indicative is marked. 'should + verb' is also accepted.
traps.label: indicative after ordered that
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Subjunctive mood, p. 55

detector.pattern: \bonce the identity of the beneficiaries would\b|\bonce the beneficiaries' identity would\b

traps.comment: No 'would' after once: 'once the identity… had been verified'.
traps.ok: once the identity of the beneficiaries had been verified
traps.no: once the identity of the beneficiaries would be verified
traps.label: conditional in a time clause
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Verb tenses: Tense sequence in complex sentences referring to the future, p. 64

spanish_text: La reducción del plazo beneficiará a quienes presenten su solicitud en línea, pero no necesariamente a quienes deban hacerlo de forma presencial.
why_this_chunk: Parallel 'those who…' clauses; present tense; keep the hedge 'not necessarily'.
suggested_ok_english_hint: quienes presenten / quienes deban: two parallel who-clauses. Which tense for future reference?
english_key: Shortening the deadline will benefit those who submit their applications online, but not necessarily those who must do so in person.
acceptables: The shorter deadline will benefit those who apply online, but not necessarily those who have to do so in person.
The reduction in the deadline will benefit people who submit their application online but not necessarily those who must apply in person.

traps.comment: Generic future clauses take the present: 'those who submit…'.
traps.label: future in the relative clause
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Verb tenses: Tense sequence in complex sentences referring to the future, p. 64

traps.comment: no necesariamente = not necessarily. The hedge must survive.
traps.label: hedge omitted
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

spanish_text: Apenas se anunció la decisión, varios representantes solicitaron una reunión para conocer las razones que la habían motivado.
why_this_chunk: apenas (time) = as soon as; 'hardly' needs 'when' and inversion.
suggested_ok_english_hint: Apenas + past = as soon as. Is it 'hardly'?
english_key: As soon as the decision was announced, several representatives requested a meeting to learn the reasons behind it.
acceptables: As soon as the decision was announced, several representatives requested a meeting to find out the reasons for it.
No sooner had the decision been announced than several representatives requested a meeting to learn what had prompted it.

traps.comment: Apenas se anunció = As soon as it was announced. 'Hardly the decision was announced' is a calque.
traps.label: apenas mistranslated
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: conocer las razones (find out) = learn / find out the reasons. 'Know' is a state, not an action.
traps.label: conocer rendered as know
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: El número de estudiantes que completaron el curso aumentó, mientras que la proporción de quienes aprobaron el examen se mantuvo estable.
why_this_chunk: 'The number of' is singular; aprobar un examen = pass, not approve.
suggested_ok_english_hint: 'The number of students… increased': singular or plural? What does aprobar el examen mean?
english_key: The number of students who completed the course increased, while the proportion of those who passed the exam remained stable.
acceptables: The number of students who completed the course rose, whereas the proportion of those who passed the examination remained steady.
The number of students completing the course increased, while the percentage who passed the exam stayed the same.

traps.comment: aprobar un examen = pass an exam. 'Approved the exam' means the students authorized it.
traps.label: aprobar rendered as approve
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

detector.pattern: \bnumber of students who completed the course have\b|\bnumber of students (who completed the course )?were\b

traps.comment: 'The number of…' takes a singular verb.
traps.label: agreement with the number of
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Collective and mass nouns, pp. 15-16

spanish_text: De acuerdo con el acta, el contrato debía renovarse antes del 30 de junio de 2025, salvo que alguna de las partes notificara su terminación.
why_this_chunk: acta = minutes; US date format Month day, year with a comma after the year.
suggested_ok_english_hint: acta = minutes, not act. How is a date written in US English?
english_key: According to the minutes, the contract was to be renewed before June 30, 2025, unless either party gave notice of termination.
acceptables: According to the minutes, the contract had to be renewed before June 30, 2025, unless one of the parties gave notice of its termination.
According to the minutes, the contract was to be renewed by June 30, 2025, unless either of the parties gave notice of termination.

traps.comment: acta (meeting) = minutes / record. 'The act' is a law.
traps.label: acta rendered as act
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: US date style: June 30, 2025, with commas after the day and after the year when the sentence continues.
traps.label: non-US date format
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Commas: Special contexts (serial comma, dates, proper names, places, quotations, parentheses), p. 21

spanish_text: No importa cuántas veces se haya revisado el procedimiento, será necesario repetir la evaluación si se detectan nuevas irregularidades.
why_this_chunk: Present after if; No importa cuántas veces = no matter how many times.
suggested_ok_english_hint: si se detectan (future possibility): which tense after if?
english_key: No matter how many times the procedure has been reviewed, the evaluation will have to be repeated if new irregularities are detected.
