acceptables: Regardless of how many times the procedure has been reviewed, the assessment will need to be repeated if new irregularities are found.
However many times the procedure may have been reviewed, it will be necessary to repeat the evaluation if new irregularities are detected.

traps.comment: No 'will' in the if-clause: 'if new irregularities are detected'.
traps.no: if new irregularities will be detected
traps.label: future in an if-clause
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Verb tenses: Tense sequence in complex sentences referring to the future, p. 64

detector.pattern: ^\s*it does not matter how many\b|^\s*it doesn't matter\b

traps.comment: No importa cuántas veces = No matter how many times. 'It does not matter…' is a calque that also creates a comma splice.
traps.no: It does not matter how many times
traps.label: no importa calqued
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Idioms, p. 31

spanish_text: La institución se comprometió a publicar los resultados, informar a los participantes y corregir los errores identificados durante la revisión.
why_this_chunk: commit to + -ing (or undertake to + inf.); parallel series.
suggested_ok_english_hint: se comprometió a + three infinitives. In English 'committed to' takes -ing. Keep all three the same.
english_key: The institution committed to publishing the results, informing the participants, and correcting the errors identified during the review.
acceptables: The institution undertook to publish the results, inform the participants, and correct the errors identified during the review.
The institution committed itself to publishing the results, informing participants, and correcting the errors found during the review.

traps.comment: commit to takes a gerund: committed to publishing. 'Committed to publish' is ungrammatical in formal US English; 'undertook to publish' is fine.
traps.label: commit to + bare infinitive
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: Keep one form across the series: publishing…, informing…, and correcting….
traps.label: mixed forms in the series
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Nonparallel constructions, p. 36

spanish_text: Sin perjuicio de las demás obligaciones establecidas en el contrato, el proveedor deberá mantener actualizados los registros de mantenimiento.
why_this_chunk: Without prejudice to (legal formula); 'up to date' after the noun is unhyphenated.
suggested_ok_english_hint: Sin perjuicio de: a fixed legal formula. Is 'up-to-date' hyphenated after a verb?
english_key: Without prejudice to the other obligations set forth in the contract, the supplier must keep the maintenance records up to date.
acceptables: Without prejudice to the other obligations established in the contract, the supplier shall keep the maintenance records up to date.
Notwithstanding the other obligations set out in the contract, the supplier must keep the maintenance logs current.

traps.comment: Predicative 'up to date' (after the noun) is not hyphenated; the hyphen is used before a noun (up-to-date records).
traps.label: hyphenated predicative compound
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Hyphens, p. 28

traps.comment: Sin perjuicio de = Without prejudice to (or Notwithstanding). 'Without damage to' is a calque.
traps.label: sin perjuicio de calqued
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Idioms, p. 31

spanish_text: Los trabajadores dijeron que habían solicitado equipos de protección desde enero, pero que no les habían informado cuándo serían entregados.
why_this_chunk: had been requesting since January; equipos = equipment; impersonal 'no les habían informado' → passive.
suggested_ok_english_hint: Two parallel reported that-clauses. Which tense goes with 'since January'? What is equipos?
english_key: The workers said that they had been requesting protective equipment since January but that they had not been told when it would be delivered.
acceptables: The workers said that they had requested protective equipment in January but had not been informed when it would be delivered.
The workers said they had been asking for protective equipment since January, but that no one had told them when it would be delivered.

traps.comment: equipos (devices) = equipment, an uncountable noun. 'Equipments' is not English; 'teams' changes the meaning.
traps.label: equipos mistranslated
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

detector.pattern: \bthey requested protective equipment since\b|\bthey have requested\b

traps.comment: An action continuing from January in a past report: had been requesting (or had requested) since January.
traps.label: simple past with since
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Verb tenses, p. 56

traps.comment: no les habían informado: keep the negation.
traps.label: negation omitted
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

spanish_text: Cuanto menos tiempo quede para concluir el proyecto, mayor será la presión sobre el equipo y más difícil resultará corregir los errores.
why_this_chunk: The comparative correlative in all three parts; 'less time' (uncountable).
suggested_ok_english_hint: Cuanto menos… mayor… más difícil: a three-part comparative frame. Use less (mass) for tiempo.
english_key: The less time there is left to complete the project, the greater the pressure on the team and the more difficult it will be to correct mistakes.
acceptables: The less time that remains to finish the project, the greater the pressure on the team and the harder it will be to correct errors.
The less time left to complete the project, the greater the pressure on the team will be and the more difficult it will be to correct the errors.

traps.comment: tiempo is uncountable: 'the less time', not 'the fewer time'.
traps.label: fewer with a mass noun
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Collective and mass nouns, pp. 15-16

detector.pattern: \band it will be more difficult\b|\band more difficult\b|^\s*(how much|while) less\b

traps.comment: Keep the frame in the third part: 'and the more difficult it will be…'. 'How much less' is a calque.
traps.ok: the more difficult it will be
traps.label: third comparative breaks the frame
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Nonparallel constructions, p. 36

traps.comment: equipo (people) = team. 'Equipment' is the other meaning.
traps.label: equipo rendered as equipment
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: La declaración fue presentada como una explicación de los hechos, no como una admisión de responsabilidad por los daños causados.
why_this_chunk: Parallel 'as an explanation…, not as an admission…'.
suggested_ok_english_hint: X, no Y: keep the two 'as' phrases parallel.
english_key: The statement was presented as an explanation of the facts, not as an admission of liability for the damage caused.
acceptables: The statement was presented as an explanation of what happened, not as an admission of responsibility for the damage caused.
The declaration was presented as an account of the facts rather than as an admission of liability for the damages caused.

detector.pattern: \bfacts, not an admission\b|\bfacts, and not admitting\b

traps.comment: Repeat 'as' in the contrast: as an explanation…, not as an admission….
traps.label: nonparallel contrast
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Nonparallel constructions, p. 36

traps.comment: no como: keep the negation / contrast.
traps.label: negation omitted
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

spanish_text: De no mediar una decisión judicial, la medida continuará vigente hasta que expire el plazo previsto en la resolución.
why_this_chunk: De no mediar = barring / unless; present after until; vigente = in effect.
suggested_ok_english_hint: De no mediar = in the absence of / barring. Which tense after until?
english_key: Unless a court rules otherwise, the measure will remain in effect until the period set out in the resolution expires.
acceptables: Barring a court decision, the measure will remain in force until the period established in the resolution expires.
In the absence of a court ruling, the measure will remain in effect until the time limit provided for in the resolution expires.

traps.comment: De no mediar una decisión judicial = Barring / In the absence of a court decision. 'Mediate' changes the meaning.
traps.no: Of not mediating a court decision
traps.label: de no mediar calqued
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Idioms, p. 31

traps.comment: No 'will' after until: 'until the period… expires'.
traps.ok: until the period set out in the resolution expires
traps.no: until the period set out in the resolution will expire
traps.label: future after until
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Verb tenses: Tense sequence in complex sentences referring to the future, p. 64

traps.comment: vigente / entrar en vigor = in effect / in force / take effect. 'Vigent' and 'vigor' are not US legal English here.
traps.label: vigente rendered as vigent / vigor
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: Pese a las objeciones formuladas por varios concejales, la propuesta fue aprobada sin que se modificaran sus condiciones principales.
why_this_chunk: concejales = council members (not councillors, a British spelling); keep 'without'.
suggested_ok_english_hint: concejales: what is the US term? sin que se modificaran: keep the negation.
english_key: Despite objections raised by several council members, the proposal was approved without any changes to its main terms.
acceptables: Despite the objections raised by several council members, the proposal was approved without its main conditions being changed.
In spite of objections from several council members, the proposal was approved without any modification to its principal terms.

traps.comment: concejales = council members (US). 'Councillors' is British spelling; 'councilors' is acceptable but less common.
traps.label: British councillors
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Non-U.S. usage, p. 37

traps.comment: sin que se modificaran = without changes. Dropping 'without' says the terms were changed.
traps.label: sin omitted
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

spanish_text: El investigador señaló que la muestra utilizada era demasiado pequeña para extraer conclusiones aplicables a toda la población.
why_this_chunk: too + adjective + to-infinitive; extraer conclusiones = draw conclusions.
suggested_ok_english_hint: demasiado pequeña para… = too small to…. What verb goes with 'conclusions'?
english_key: The researcher noted that the sample used was too small to draw conclusions applicable to the entire population.
acceptables: The researcher pointed out that the sample used was too small to draw conclusions that could be applied to the whole population.
The researcher stated that the sample was too small for conclusions applicable to the entire population to be drawn.

traps.comment: extraer conclusiones = draw conclusions. 'Extract conclusions' is unidiomatic.
traps.label: conclusions with a calqued verb
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Idioms, p. 31

traps.comment: demasiado… para + inf. = too… to + inf.
traps.label: too… for + verb
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

spanish_text: Las obras podrán reanudarse siempre que la empresa demuestre que se han corregido las deficiencias detectadas durante la inspección.
errors_to_catch: siempre que rendered as always / whenever
why_this_chunk: siempre que = provided that; present (not will) in the condition clause.
suggested_ok_english_hint: siempre que + subjunctive: condition or frequency? Which tense in the condition clause?
english_key: Construction may resume provided that the company demonstrates that the deficiencies found during the inspection have been corrected.
acceptables: The work may resume provided that the company shows that the deficiencies detected during the inspection have been corrected.
Construction can resume as long as the company proves that the deficiencies identified during the inspection have been remedied.

traps.comment: siempre que / siempre y cuando + subjunctive = provided that / as long as. It is a condition, not 'always' or 'whenever'.
traps.label: siempre que rendered as always / whenever
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

detector.pattern: \b(provided that|as long as|provided) the company will\b

traps.comment: No 'will' in the condition clause: 'provided that the company demonstrates…'.
traps.label: future in a condition clause
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Verb tenses: Tense sequence in complex sentences referring to the future, p. 64

traps.comment: obras = construction / the work.
traps.label: obras rendered as the works
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Non-U.S. usage, p. 37

spanish_text: Lo que preocupa a los residentes no es tanto el aumento de las tarifas como la falta de información sobre su cálculo.
why_this_chunk: not so much X as Y (parallel nouns); tarifas = rates / fees.
suggested_ok_english_hint: no es tanto… como…: which English frame? What are tarifas?
english_key: What concerns residents is not so much the rate increase as the lack of information about how it was calculated.
acceptables: What worries residents is not so much the increase in rates as the lack of information about how they are calculated.
What concerns residents is not so much the rise in fees as the lack of information about how they are calculated.

detector.pattern: \bnot so much the [^.]*\bbut\b|\bnot so much the [^.]*\bthan\b|\bnot as much the [^.]*\bthan\b

traps.comment: no es tanto… como… = not so much X as Y. 'Not so much… but / than' breaks the pair.
traps.label: not so much… than / but
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Nonparallel constructions, p. 36

traps.comment: tarifas (utilities) = rates / fees. 'Tariffs' are import duties in US English.
traps.label: tarifas rendered as tariffs
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: Cuando se conozcan los resultados definitivos, el comité decidirá si conviene ampliar el programa o mantener su alcance actual.
why_this_chunk: Present after when for future time; whether… or… parallel infinitives.
suggested_ok_english_hint: Cuando se conozcan (future): which tense after when? si = whether here.
english_key: When the final results are known, the committee will decide whether to expand the program or maintain its current scope.
acceptables: Once the final results are known, the committee will decide whether it is advisable to expand the program or maintain its current scope.
When the definitive results are available, the committee will decide whether to extend the program or keep its current scope.

detector.pattern: \bwhen the final results will\b|\bwhen the definitive results will\b

traps.comment: No 'will' after when: 'When the final results are known'.
traps.ok: When the final results are known
traps.no: When the final results will be known
traps.label: future after when
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Verb tenses: Tense sequence in complex sentences referring to the future, p. 64

traps.comment: US target: program, not programme.
traps.label: programme (non-US spelling)
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Non-U.S. usage, p. 37

traps.comment: Keep the pair in one form: whether to expand… or maintain….
traps.label: nonparallel pair
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Nonparallel constructions, p. 36

spanish_text: La funcionaria que firmó la comunicación explicó después que no había tenido acceso a todos los documentos pertinentes.
errors_to_catch: commas added to a restrictive clause
why_this_chunk: Restrictive clause (no commas); she (funcionaria) is relevant here as the referent.
suggested_ok_english_hint: La funcionaria que firmó: which official? Who had no access? Keep the past perfect and negation.
english_key: The official who signed the letter later explained that she had not had access to all the relevant documents.
acceptables: The official who signed the communication explained afterward that she had not had access to all of the relevant documents.
The official who signed the notice subsequently explained that she had not had access to all the pertinent documents.

traps.comment: The clause identifies which official; it is restrictive, so no comma before who/that.
traps.label: commas added to a restrictive clause
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Restrictive and nonrestrictive clauses and appositives, p. 48

traps.comment: no había tenido acceso: keep the negation.
traps.label: negation omitted
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: funcionaria = official / civil servant.
traps.label: funcionaria rendered as functionary
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: Ni siquiera quienes apoyaron inicialmente la reforma pudieron explicar por qué se habían eliminado algunas garantías previstas en el texto original.
why_this_chunk: Ni siquiera = not even; the negative must remain.
suggested_ok_english_hint: Ni siquiera: the negation scopes over the subject. Don't lose it.
english_key: Not even those who initially supported the reform could explain why some of the safeguards in the original text had been eliminated.
acceptables: Not even those who had initially supported the reform were able to explain why some guarantees provided for in the original text had been removed.
Even those who initially supported the reform could not explain why certain safeguards contained in the original text had been eliminated.

traps.comment: Ni siquiera = not even. Dropping it says that the supporters could explain.
traps.label: ni siquiera omitted
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: garantías (in a reform) = safeguards / guarantees. 'Warranties' is the product sense.
traps.label: garantías rendered as warranties
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: A fin de evitar interpretaciones contradictorias, la comisión propuso definir con mayor precisión las funciones de cada dependencia.
why_this_chunk: propose + -ing; dependencia = department / office (not dependency).
suggested_ok_english_hint: propuso definir: propose takes -ing or a that-clause with subjunctive. What is a dependencia?
english_key: To avoid contradictory interpretations, the commission proposed defining the functions of each department more precisely.
acceptables: In order to avoid conflicting interpretations, the commission proposed defining the duties of each department more precisely.
To prevent contradictory interpretations, the commission proposed that the functions of each office be defined more precisely.

traps.comment: In this sense, 'propose' takes a gerund or a that-clause: proposed defining / proposed that… be defined.
traps.label: propose + to-infinitive (intention sense)
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: dependencia (government) = department / office / unit.
traps.label: dependencia rendered as dependency
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: El convenio establece que ambas instituciones compartirán información, coordinarán sus actividades y evaluarán conjuntamente los resultados obtenidos.
why_this_chunk: Parallel verb series; convenio = agreement (not convention).
suggested_ok_english_hint: convenio = agreement. Three parallel verbs after 'will'.
english_key: The agreement provides that both institutions will share information, coordinate their activities, and jointly evaluate the results obtained.
acceptables: The agreement establishes that both institutions will share information, coordinate their activities, and jointly assess the results obtained.
The agreement stipulates that the two institutions will share information, coordinate their activities, and evaluate the results jointly.

traps.comment: convenio (between institutions) = agreement. 'Convention' is a treaty or assembly.
traps.label: convenio rendered as convention
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

detector.pattern: \b(coordinating their activities|and jointly evaluating|and the joint evaluation)\b

traps.comment: Keep the series: will share…, coordinate…, and evaluate….
traps.label: mixed forms in the series
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Nonparallel constructions, p. 36

spanish_text: Si el informe hubiera incluido los datos correspondientes al período anterior, habría sido posible determinar si el aumento era excepcional.
why_this_chunk: Third conditional; si after determinar = whether.
suggested_ok_english_hint: Si hubiera incluido… habría sido posible: past counterfactual. si = if or whether?
english_key: If the report had included the data for the previous period, it would have been possible to determine whether the increase was exceptional.
acceptables: Had the report included the data for the previous period, it would have been possible to determine whether the increase was exceptional.
If the report had included the corresponding data for the previous period, it would have been possible to establish whether the rise was exceptional.

detector.pattern: \bif the report would have\b|\bit would be possible to determine\b|\bif the report included\b

traps.comment: Past counterfactual: 'If the report had included…, it would have been possible…'.
traps.label: broken third conditional
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Conditional tenses, p. 23

traps.comment: determinar si = determine whether. 'If' after determine is informal and can be ambiguous in formal prose.
traps.label: if for whether
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Register, p. 45

spanish_text: El médico que atendió a los primeros pacientes señaló que ninguno presentaba síntomas que justificaran una hospitalización inmediata.
errors_to_catch: commas added to a restrictive clause
why_this_chunk: Restrictive who-clause; keep 'none'; atender = treat (not attend).
suggested_ok_english_hint: ninguno = none (negation). Which doctor? atender a pacientes = treat.
english_key: The physician who treated the first patients noted that none of them had symptoms that warranted immediate hospitalization.
acceptables: The doctor who treated the first patients noted that none of them showed symptoms that would justify immediate hospitalization.
The physician who saw the first patients pointed out that none had symptoms warranting immediate hospitalization.

traps.comment: ninguno presentaba = none had. Losing it says all had serious symptoms.
traps.label: ninguno lost
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: atender a pacientes = treat / see patients. 'Attended the patients' sounds like 'attended an event'.
traps.label: atender rendered as attend
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: The clause identifies which physician; it is restrictive, so no comma before who/that.
traps.label: commas added to a restrictive clause
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Restrictive and nonrestrictive clauses and appositives, p. 48

spanish_text: La doctora Ramírez, quien dirigió el estudio, afirmó que las conclusiones debían interpretarse con cautela debido al tamaño de la muestra.
why_this_chunk: Title 'Dr.' before the name; the accent in Ramírez is kept; nonrestrictive clause in commas.
suggested_ok_english_hint: La doctora Ramírez: how is the title abbreviated and capitalized in English? Is the who-clause essential?
english_key: Dr. Ramírez, who led the study, stated that the conclusions should be interpreted with caution because of the sample size.
acceptables: Dr. Ramírez, who directed the study, stated that the conclusions should be interpreted cautiously given the size of the sample.
Dr. Ramírez, who led the study, said that the conclusions had to be interpreted with caution due to the sample size.

traps.comment: La doctora Ramírez = Dr. Ramírez. English drops the article and capitalizes the abbreviated title.
traps.label: title lowercased / article kept
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Abbreviated forms and titles, p. 4

traps.comment: The named person is already identified; the clause is nonrestrictive and must be set off by commas (not dashes).
traps.label: nonrestrictive commas missing
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Restrictive and nonrestrictive clauses and appositives, p. 48

traps.comment: La doctora: 'Dr.' is neutral; adding 'female' adds information.
traps.label: gender added
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, He/she and gender-specific terms, p. 27

spanish_text: En vez de limitarse a publicar las cifras, la entidad debería explicar cómo se obtuvieron y por qué difieren de las estimaciones iniciales.
why_this_chunk: limitarse a = simply / merely; parallel embedded questions; cifras = figures.
suggested_ok_english_hint: En vez de limitarse a: what does limitarse a add? Two parallel how/why questions.
english_key: Rather than simply publishing the figures, the agency should explain how they were obtained and why they differ from the initial estimates.
acceptables: Instead of merely publishing the figures, the agency should explain how they were obtained and why they differ from the initial estimates.
Rather than just publishing the numbers, the agency ought to explain how they were arrived at and why they differ from the original estimates.

traps.comment: cifras = figures / numbers. 'Ciphers' are codes.
traps.label: cifras rendered as ciphers
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: entidad (public body) = agency / office / institution. 'The entity' is stiff legalese in US English.
traps.label: entidad rendered as entity
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: diferir de = differ from.
traps.label: wrong preposition after differ
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

spanish_text: No todos los solicitantes que cumplan los requisitos recibirán el subsidio, pues los recursos disponibles solo permitirán beneficiar a una parte.
why_this_chunk: Not all… will (partial); present in the who-clause; resources allow only some.
suggested_ok_english_hint: No todos: partial negation. cumplan (future reference): which tense? permitir needs an object.
english_key: Not all applicants who meet the requirements will receive the subsidy, since the available resources will only be enough to benefit some of them.
acceptables: Not all of the applicants who meet the requirements will receive the subsidy, as the available resources will allow only some of them to benefit.
Not every applicant who meets the requirements will receive the subsidy, because the resources available will only make it possible to help some of them.

detector.pattern: ^\s*all (of )?the applicants\b[^,]*\bwill not\b|^\s*all applicants\b[^,]*\bwill not\b|^\s*all applicants who meet the requirements will receive\b|^\s*no applicants\b|^\s*none of the applicants\b

traps.comment: No todos = not all (partial). 'All applicants… will not receive' reads as 'none will'.
traps.label: partial negation became total
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: Generic future relative clause takes the present: 'applicants who meet'.
traps.label: future in the relative clause
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Verb tenses: Tense sequence in complex sentences referring to the future, p. 64

traps.comment: recursos (budget) = resources / funds.
traps.label: recursos mistranslated
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: Si bien se trata de una medida temporal, sus efectos podrían prolongarse más allá de la fecha prevista para su terminación.
errors_to_catch: si bien rendered as if / even if
why_this_chunk: si bien = although (fact); se trata de = this is.
suggested_ok_english_hint: Si bien se trata de: concession of fact. Is it 'if well' or 'even if'?
english_key: Although this is a temporary measure, its effects could extend beyond the date set for its termination.
acceptables: While this is a temporary measure, its effects could last beyond the date planned for its end.
Although the measure is temporary, its effects might extend beyond its scheduled end date.

traps.comment: si bien = although / while (a concession of fact). 'Even if' or 'if' turns a fact into a hypothesis.
traps.label: si bien rendered as if / even if
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: se trata de = it is / this is. 'It treats of' is a calque.
traps.no: it treats of a temporary measure
traps.label: se trata de calqued
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Idioms, p. 31

spanish_text: El estudio reveló que cerca del 40 % de los encuestados desconocía la existencia del programa y que pocos sabían cómo solicitarlo.
errors_to_catch: singular verb with percentage of a plural
why_this_chunk: US style 40% (no space); a plural verb with '40% of respondents'; desconocía = were unaware.
suggested_ok_english_hint: 40 %: how does US English write a percentage? Two parallel that-clauses; cerca de = about.
english_key: The study revealed that about 40% of respondents were unaware that the program existed and that few knew how to apply for it.
acceptables: The study revealed that nearly 40% of respondents were unaware of the program's existence and that few knew how to apply for it.
The study found that around 40% of those surveyed did not know that the program existed and that few knew how to apply for it.

traps.comment: US style writes 40% with no space (or 40 percent). '40 %' follows the Spanish / RAE style; 'per cent' is British.
traps.label: non-US percent style
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Non-U.S. usage, p. 37

traps.comment: desconocía = was unaware / did not know. Dropping the negation reverses the finding.
traps.label: desconocer read as conocer
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: With a plural of-phrase, a percentage takes a plural verb: '40% of respondents were'.
traps.label: singular verb with percentage of a plural
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Collective and mass nouns, pp. 15-16

spanish_text: De haberse comunicado la nueva política con mayor claridad, probablemente se habrían evitado las reclamaciones presentadas durante las primeras semanas.
errors_to_catch: De haberse calqued as of having
why_this_chunk: Had… been / If… had been; reclamaciones = complaints / claims.
suggested_ok_english_hint: De haberse comunicado… se habrían evitado: past counterfactual. What are reclamaciones?
english_key: Had the new policy been communicated more clearly, the complaints filed during the first few weeks would probably have been avoided.
acceptables: If the new policy had been communicated more clearly, the complaints filed in the first weeks would probably have been avoided.
Had the new policy been explained more clearly, the claims submitted during the first weeks would likely have been prevented.

traps.comment: De + perfect infinitive = If… had… / Had…. 'Of having' is a word-for-word calque.
traps.ok: Had the new policy been communicated
traps.no: Of having communicated the new policy
traps.label: De haberse calqued as of having
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Conditional tenses, p. 23

traps.comment: reclamación = complaint / claim. 'Reclamation' means recovering land or materials.
traps.label: reclamación rendered as reclamation
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: política (rule) = policy. 'Politics' is government activity.
traps.label: política rendered as politics
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: La gerencia pidió que se realizara una evaluación independiente y se publicaran sus resultados antes de decidir si continuaba el proyecto.
why_this_chunk: Mandative subjunctive (be carried out… be published); realizar ≠ realize; gerencia = management.
suggested_ok_english_hint: pidió que + two subjunctives. Which form after requested that? What is realizar?
english_key: Management requested that an independent evaluation be carried out and that its results be published before deciding whether to continue the project.
acceptables: Management asked for an independent evaluation to be carried out and its results to be published before deciding whether to continue with the project.
Management requested that an independent assessment be conducted and its results published before a decision was made on whether to continue the project.

detector.pattern: \brequested that an independent (evaluation|assessment) (was|is|would be) (carried out|conducted)\b|\band that its results (were|would be) published\b

traps.comment: After requested that…, US English uses the present (mandative) subjunctive: that X be…, that X identify…. The indicative is marked. 'should + verb' is also accepted.
traps.ok: an independent evaluation be carried out
traps.no: an independent evaluation was carried out
traps.label: indicative after requested that
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Subjunctive mood, p. 55

traps.comment: realizar = carry out / conduct / make. 'Realize' means to become aware of something.
traps.label: realizar rendered as realize
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: la gerencia = management.
traps.label: gerencia mistranslated
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: Aunque las dos propuestas parecían similares, la segunda ofrecía más garantías y exigía una inversión inicial considerablemente menor.
why_this_chunk: Parallel verbs (offered… required); menor inversión = smaller / lower investment.
suggested_ok_english_hint: more guarantees and smaller investment: two parallel verbs. Which adjective goes with investment?
english_key: Although the two proposals seemed similar, the second offered more guarantees and required a considerably smaller initial investment.
acceptables: Although the two proposals appeared similar, the second one offered more guarantees and required a considerably lower initial investment.
Even though the two proposals seemed similar, the second provided more safeguards and called for a significantly smaller initial investment.

traps.comment: menor inversión = smaller / lower investment. 'Minor investment' and 'lesser investment' are unidiomatic.
traps.label: menor calqued as minor
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: Keep both verbs parallel: offered… and required….
traps.label: nonparallel verbs
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Nonparallel constructions, p. 36

spanish_text: El documento, cuya versión definitiva aún no se había publicado, contenía referencias a disposiciones que habían sido derogadas.
why_this_chunk: Nonrestrictive whose-clause in commas; derogar = repeal; disposiciones = provisions.
suggested_ok_english_hint: cuya = whose (nonrestrictive here). What does derogar mean? disposiciones?
english_key: The document, whose final version had not yet been published, contained references to provisions that had been repealed.
acceptables: The document, the final version of which had not yet been published, contained references to provisions that had been repealed.
The document, whose final version had not yet been released, referred to provisions that had since been repealed.

traps.comment: derogar = repeal / revoke. In English, 'derogate' means to detract or disparage.
traps.label: derogar rendered as derogate
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: disposiciones (legal) = provisions. 'Dispositions' are temperaments.
traps.label: disposiciones rendered as dispositions
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: The document is already identified; the clause is nonrestrictive and must be set off by commas (not dashes).
traps.label: nonrestrictive commas missing
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Restrictive and nonrestrictive clauses and appositives, p. 48

spanish_text: Los responsables aseguraron haber seguido el procedimiento establecido, pero ninguno pudo presentar las actas que respaldaran esa afirmación.
why_this_chunk: Keep 'none'; actas = minutes / records (not acts).
suggested_ok_english_hint: ninguno pudo: keep the negation. What are actas here?
english_key: Those responsible claimed to have followed the established procedure, but none of them could produce the records to support that claim.
acceptables: The officials in charge claimed that they had followed the established procedure, but none of them was able to produce the minutes that would support that claim.
Those responsible asserted that they had followed the established procedure, but none of them could present the records backing up that statement.

traps.comment: ninguno pudo = none of them could. The negation must survive.
traps.label: ninguno lost
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: actas = minutes / records. 'Acts' are laws or deeds.
traps.label: actas rendered as acts
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: Sea cual sea el resultado de la negociación, ambas partes deberán cumplir las obligaciones que asumieron al firmar el acuerdo.
why_this_chunk: Sea cual sea = whatever / regardless of; US 'fulfill'.
suggested_ok_english_hint: Sea cual sea = whatever. US spelling of fulfil?
english_key: Whatever the outcome of the negotiations, both parties must fulfill the obligations they assumed when they signed the agreement.
acceptables: Regardless of the outcome of the negotiation, both parties must comply with the obligations they undertook when signing the agreement.
Whatever the result of the negotiations may be, both parties will have to fulfill the obligations they assumed upon signing the agreement.

traps.comment: US target: fulfill, not fulfil.
traps.label: fulfil (non-US spelling)
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Non-U.S. usage, p. 37

detector.pattern: ^\s*(be which be|be what may be|be it which)\b

traps.comment: Sea cual sea = Whatever / Regardless of. A word-for-word calque is unreadable.
traps.label: sea cual sea calqued
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Idioms, p. 31

spanish_text: Solo después de recibir las observaciones de los afectados se decidirá si resulta necesario modificar el reglamento.
why_this_chunk: Only after… + auxiliary inversion (will it be decided); reglamento = regulations.
suggested_ok_english_hint: Fronted 'Only after…' triggers inversion in English. What is reglamento?
english_key: Only after receiving the comments of those affected will it be decided whether it is necessary to amend the regulations.
acceptables: Only after the comments from those affected have been received will a decision be made on whether the regulations need to be amended.
Only after receiving feedback from those affected will it be decided whether the regulations need to be amended.

detector.pattern: ^\s*only after [^,]*?\b(it will be|a decision will be|the decision will be)\b

why_this_chunk: Both to X and to Y (matching halves); oportuna = timely, not opportune.

traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

spanish_text: El alcalde dijo que se habían adoptado medidas para reducir la contaminación, sin precisar cuáles habían sido sus resultados.
why_this_chunk: sin precisar = without specifying (the mayor); contaminación = pollution.
suggested_ok_english_hint: sin precisar: who did not specify? Make sure the modifier attaches to the mayor. contaminación = ?
english_key: The mayor said that measures had been taken to reduce pollution, without specifying what their results had been.
acceptables: The mayor said that measures had been adopted to reduce pollution but did not specify what the results had been.
The mayor stated that steps had been taken to reduce pollution, without specifying what results they had produced.

traps.comment: contaminación (air, environment) = pollution. 'Contamination' is narrower (food, water, radiation).
traps.label: contaminación rendered as contamination
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: sin precisar = without specifying.
traps.label: precisar mistranslated
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: A condición de que se mantengan los niveles actuales de financiación, el programa podría extenderse a otras cuatro regiones.
why_this_chunk: Present in the condition clause; 'four more / four other regions'.
suggested_ok_english_hint: A condición de que + subjunctive: which tense in the condition? otras cuatro regiones = ?
english_key: Provided that current funding levels are maintained, the program could be extended to four more regions.
acceptables: On condition that current funding levels are maintained, the program could be expanded to another four regions.
As long as the current levels of funding are maintained, the program could be extended to four other regions.

detector.pattern: \b(provided that|on condition that|as long as) (the )?current (funding )?levels (of funding )?(will|would) be\b

traps.comment: No will/would in the condition clause: 'Provided that current funding levels are maintained'.
traps.label: future in a condition clause
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Verb tenses: Tense sequence in complex sentences referring to the future, p. 64

traps.comment: otras cuatro regiones = four more / four other / another four regions. 'Other four' is a calque.
traps.label: numeral after other
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: US target: program, not programme.
traps.label: programme (non-US spelling)
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Non-U.S. usage, p. 37

spanish_text: El informe distingue entre los costos que corresponden a la instalación y aquellos que surgirán durante la operación del sistema.
why_this_chunk: between X and Y (not 'between X or Y'); those that refers back to costs.
suggested_ok_english_hint: aquellos que = those that. Keep 'between X and Y' parallel.
english_key: The report distinguishes between the costs related to installation and those that will arise during the operation of the system.
acceptables: The report distinguishes between costs corresponding to installation and those that will arise while the system is in operation.
The report makes a distinction between the installation costs and the costs that will arise during system operation.

traps.comment: distinguish between X and Y. 'Between… or' and 'between… from' break the pair.
traps.label: between… or / from
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Nonparallel constructions, p. 36

traps.comment: aquellos que = those that (referring to costs).
traps.label: wrong referent pronoun
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Anaphora / Referents, p. 8

spanish_text: Aun reconociendo los avances alcanzados, los expertos consideraron necesario revisar los indicadores utilizados para medir los resultados.
why_this_chunk: Concessive participle attached to the experts; 'considered it necessary' needs the dummy it.
suggested_ok_english_hint: Aun reconociendo: a concessive gerund with the experts as subject. consideraron necesario = considered it necessary.
english_key: While acknowledging the progress achieved, the experts considered it necessary to review the indicators used to measure the results.
acceptables: Although they acknowledged the progress made, the experts considered it necessary to revise the indicators used to measure the results.
Even while recognizing the progress that had been achieved, the experts deemed it necessary to review the indicators used to measure results.

traps.comment: consideraron necesario + inf. = considered it necessary to. English needs the dummy 'it'.
traps.label: missing dummy it
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: The concessive phrase must attach to the experts.
traps.no: it was considered by the experts
traps.label: dangling concessive phrase
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Dangling modifiers, p. 25

spanish_text: La nueva directora, junto con sus asesores, asistió a la reunión en la que se discutieron los principales desafíos del sector.
why_this_chunk: 'X, along with Y,' takes a singular verb; asistir = attend.
suggested_ok_english_hint: junto con: the verb agrees with 'director' (singular). asistió = attended. en la que = at which.
english_key: The new director, along with her advisers, attended the meeting at which the main challenges facing the sector were discussed.
acceptables: The new director, together with her advisors, attended the meeting in which the main challenges of the sector were discussed.
The new director, accompanied by her advisers, attended the meeting where the sector's main challenges were discussed.

traps.comment: The subject is 'the new director'; 'along with her advisers' is parenthetical and does not make it plural.
traps.label: plural verb with along with
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Collective and mass nouns, pp. 15-16

traps.comment: asistir a = attend.
traps.label: asistir rendered as assist
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: La nueva directora: 'director' is neutral; 'her advisers' already shows gender.
traps.label: gender added
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, He/she and gender-specific terms, p. 27

spanish_text: De acuerdo con las cifras oficiales, durante el segundo trimestre se recibieron 12.750 solicitudes, aproximadamente un tercio más que en el anterior.
errors_to_catch: decimal point used as thousands separator
why_this_chunk: US comma thousands separator (12,750); trimestre = quarter (not trimester).
suggested_ok_english_hint: 12.750: US thousands separator? trimestre = quarter. cifras = figures.
english_key: According to official figures, 12,750 applications were received in the second quarter, approximately a third more than in the previous quarter.
acceptables: According to official figures, 12,750 applications were received during the second quarter, about a third more than in the previous one.
According to the official figures, 12,750 applications were received in the second quarter, roughly one-third more than in the first quarter.

traps.comment: US English separates thousands with a comma: 12,750.
traps.label: decimal point used as thousands separator
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Numbers, p. 37

traps.comment: trimestre (fiscal) = quarter. 'Trimester' is used for pregnancy or school terms.
traps.label: trimestre rendered as trimester
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: cifras = figures.
traps.label: cifras rendered as ciphers
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: No se había informado a los usuarios de los cambios ni se les había ofrecido un mecanismo para presentar observaciones.
why_this_chunk: not… or (shared negation); 'nor' needs inversion (nor had they…).
suggested_ok_english_hint: No se había informado… ni se les había ofrecido: after 'had not', or; or a new clause with 'nor had they'.
english_key: Users had not been informed of the changes or offered a mechanism for submitting comments.
acceptables: The users had not been informed of the changes, nor had they been offered a mechanism for submitting comments.
Users had neither been informed of the changes nor been given a way to submit comments.

traps.comment: After 'had not been informed', join with 'or'; 'nor' needs its own inverted clause ('nor had they been offered').
traps.label: nor after not without inversion
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Nonparallel constructions, p. 36

traps.comment: No se había informado: keep the negation.
traps.label: negation omitted
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

spanish_text: En principio, la medida se aplicará únicamente a las entidades públicas; no obstante, algunas empresas privadas podrían verse afectadas indirectamente.
why_this_chunk: only must survive; semicolon + however + comma.
suggested_ok_english_hint: únicamente: keep the restriction. ; no obstante, — semicolon before however.
english_key: In principle, the measure will apply only to public entities; however, some private companies could be indirectly affected.
acceptables: In principle, the measure will only apply to public agencies; however, some private companies may be affected indirectly.
In principle, the measure will apply exclusively to public bodies; nevertheless, some private companies could be indirectly affected.

traps.comment: únicamente limits the scope. Dropping 'only' turns a restriction into a general statement.
traps.label: únicamente omitted (only)
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: 'However' between independent clauses needs a semicolon before it.
traps.label: comma splice before however
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Commas: Conjunctive adverbs, p. 18

spanish_text: El tribunal concluyó que la omisión no había sido intencional, aunque sí había impedido que los interesados ejercieran oportunamente su derecho de defensa.
why_this_chunk: impedir que = prevent… from -ing; US 'defense'; oportunamente = in a timely manner.
suggested_ok_english_hint: aunque sí había impedido: impedir que = prevent from. US spelling of defence?
english_key: The court concluded that the omission had not been intentional, although it had prevented the interested parties from exercising their right of defense in a timely manner.
acceptables: The court concluded that the omission had not been intentional, although it had indeed prevented the parties concerned from exercising their right to a defense in a timely manner.
The court found that the omission had not been intentional, even though it had prevented the interested parties from exercising their right of defense in due time.

traps.comment: US target: defense, not defence.
traps.label: defence (non-US spelling)
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Non-U.S. usage, p. 37

traps.comment: impedir que + subj. = prevent X from -ing. 'Prevented that' or 'prevented X to' is ungrammatical.
traps.ok: prevented the interested parties from exercising
traps.no: prevented the interested parties to exercise
traps.label: impedir que calqued
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: no había sido intencional: keep the negation.
traps.label: negation omitted
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

spanish_text: La decisión de cerrar temporalmente la biblioteca, que fue anunciada el martes, sorprendió a los estudiantes que preparaban sus exámenes.
errors_to_catch: announcement attached to the wrong noun
commas added to a restrictive clause
why_this_chunk: The decision was announced; recast so the English cannot attach 'announced' to the library. Which students? (restrictive)
suggested_ok_english_hint: Ambiguous source: 'que fue anunciada' could attach to la decisión or la biblioteca (both feminine). What was announced on Tuesday?
english_key: The decision, announced on Tuesday, to close the library temporarily surprised students who were preparing for their exams.
acceptables: The decision to temporarily close the library was announced on Tuesday and surprised the students who were studying for their exams.
The decision to close the library temporarily, which was announced on Tuesday, surprised students who were preparing for their exams.

traps.comment: Grammatical ambiguity in the source: make clear that the decision (not the library) was announced. 'The library, which was announced' can misread.
traps.ok: The decision, announced on Tuesday, to close the library
traps.no: The decision to close the library, which was announced on Tuesday,
traps.label: announcement attached to the wrong noun
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Grammatical ambiguity in the source language, p. 26

traps.comment: The clause identifies which students; it is restrictive, so no comma before who/that.
traps.label: commas added to a restrictive clause
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Restrictive and nonrestrictive clauses and appositives, p. 48

traps.comment: English capitalizes days of the week (Tuesday).
traps.label: day lowercased
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

spanish_text: Más que una solución permanente, el nuevo esquema constituye una respuesta provisional a las dificultades identificadas durante la evaluación.
why_this_chunk: Más que = rather than; esquema = arrangement / plan (US 'scheme' has a negative connotation).
suggested_ok_english_hint: Más que = rather than. esquema in US English: plan / arrangement. 'Scheme' can sound shady.
english_key: Rather than a permanent solution, the new arrangement is a provisional response to the difficulties identified during the evaluation.
acceptables: Instead of a permanent solution, the new plan represents a temporary response to the difficulties identified during the assessment.
Rather than being a permanent solution, the new arrangement constitutes a provisional response to the difficulties identified in the evaluation.

traps.comment: esquema = arrangement / plan / system. In US English 'scheme' often implies a dishonest plan; British usage is neutral.
traps.label: scheme (negative in US usage)
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Non-U.S. usage, p. 37

detector.pattern: ^\s*more than a permanent solution, the new (arrangement|plan|system) is\b

traps.comment: Más que = Rather than (substitution). 'More than a permanent solution, it is…' can read as 'in addition to'.
traps.label: más que calqued
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Idioms, p. 31

spanish_text: Puesto que el plazo vencía el viernes, los representantes solicitaron una prórroga que les permitiera reunir los documentos pendientes.
why_this_chunk: prórroga = extension; permitir needs an object (allow them to).
suggested_ok_english_hint: prórroga = extension (not prorogation). Puesto que = since / because.
english_key: Since the deadline was Friday, the representatives requested an extension that would allow them to gather the outstanding documents.
acceptables: Because the deadline expired on Friday, the representatives asked for an extension that would enable them to collect the pending documents.
As the deadline was on Friday, the representatives requested an extension so that they could gather the outstanding documents.

traps.comment: prórroga = extension. 'Prorogation' is the suspension of a parliament.
traps.label: prórroga rendered as prorogation
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: permitir + infinitive: English needs an object (allowed X to…, made it possible to…). 'Allowed to verb' with no object is ungrammatical.
traps.label: allow to + verb without object
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: Puesto que = Since / Because. A word-for-word calque is unreadable.
traps.label: puesto que calqued
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Idioms, p. 31

spanish_text: Cuando menos se esperaba, surgió una discrepancia entre el número de beneficiarios registrados y la cantidad de pagos efectivamente realizados.
errors_to_catch: cuando menos misread as at least
why_this_chunk: cuando menos se esperaba = when it was least expected; efectivamente = actually.
suggested_ok_english_hint: Cuando menos se esperaba: when least expected (not 'at least'). efectivamente realizados = actually made.
english_key: When it was least expected, a discrepancy emerged between the number of registered beneficiaries and the number of payments actually made.
acceptables: When it was least expected, a discrepancy arose between the number of registered beneficiaries and the number of payments actually made.
Just when it was least expected, a discrepancy appeared between the number of beneficiaries registered and the number of payments that had actually been made.

traps.comment: Cuando menos se esperaba = When it was least expected. Reading 'cuando menos' as 'at least' changes the meaning.
traps.label: cuando menos misread as at least
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Idioms, p. 31

traps.comment: efectivamente realizados = actually made. 'Effectively' means efficiently or in effect.
traps.label: efectivamente rendered as effectively
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: realizar = carry out / conduct / make. 'Realize' means to become aware of something.
traps.label: realizar rendered as realize
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: El estudio recomienda que se protejan los datos personales, se limite el acceso a la información y se establezcan mecanismos de supervisión.
why_this_chunk: Mandative subjunctive in all three items; keep the series parallel.
suggested_ok_english_hint: recomienda que se protejan… se limite… se establezcan: three parallel subjunctive passives.
english_key: The study recommends that personal data be protected, that access to information be limited, and that oversight mechanisms be established.
acceptables: The study recommends that personal data be protected, access to information be limited, and supervision mechanisms be established.
The study recommends protecting personal data, limiting access to information, and establishing oversight mechanisms.

detector.pattern: \bthat personal data (is|are|will be) protected\b|\bthat access to (the )?information (is|will be) limited\b|\bthat oversight mechanisms (are|will be) established\b

traps.comment: After recommend that…, US English uses the present (mandative) subjunctive: that X be…, that X identify…. The indicative is marked. 'should + verb' is also accepted.
traps.label: indicative after recommend that
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Subjunctive mood, p. 55

traps.comment: Keep one structure for all three items (all 'that… be' or all gerunds).
traps.ok: that access to information be limited
traps.label: mixed forms in the series
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Nonparallel constructions, p. 36

spanish_text: Ni siquiera después de publicarse el informe quedó claro si las cifras incluían los gastos de mantenimiento o solo los de instalación.
why_this_chunk: Not even after… was it clear (inversion); keep 'only'; cifras = figures.
suggested_ok_english_hint: Ni siquiera después de: negative scope plus inversion. Keep 'only'.
english_key: Not even after the report was published was it clear whether the figures included maintenance costs or only installation costs.
acceptables: Even after the report was published, it was still not clear whether the figures included maintenance costs or only installation costs.
Not even after the publication of the report did it become clear whether the figures included maintenance expenses or only installation expenses.

traps.comment: Ni siquiera… quedó claro = Not even after… was it clear. Losing the negation says it became clear.
traps.label: ni siquiera omitted
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: solo limits the scope. Dropping 'only' turns a restriction into a general statement.
traps.label: solo omitted (only)
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: A fronted negative ('Not even after…') requires inversion: '…was it clear…'.
traps.label: no inversion
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

spanish_text: Aunque la solicitud fue presentada oportunamente, su aprobación dependía de que se verificaran varios requisitos que aún no se habían acreditado.
why_this_chunk: depend on (not of); keep 'not yet'; acreditar = demonstrate / prove.
suggested_ok_english_hint: acreditar = prove / substantiate. aún no se habían acreditado: keep the negation and the past perfect.
english_key: Although the application was submitted on time, its approval depended on the verification of several requirements that had not yet been met.
acceptables: Although the application was filed in a timely manner, its approval was contingent on verifying several requirements that had not yet been satisfied.
Although the application had been submitted on time, its approval depended on several requirements being verified, which had not yet been demonstrated.

traps.comment: dependía de que = depended on (+ gerund / noun). 'Depended of' and 'depended that' are calques.
traps.label: wrong preposition after depend
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: aún no se habían acreditado: keep the negation.
traps.label: negation omitted
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: acreditar requisitos = prove / demonstrate / show that requirements are met. 'Accredited' means officially recognized.
traps.label: acreditar rendered as accredited
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10
